Bonchcho Tewofiloosa, nu giddon polettidabas daroti, banttaw dandda7ettida mela xaafidosona.
He taarikiya entti xaafiday koyroppe doomidi ayfe markkatinne qaala haggaazeyssati nuus odidayssa.
Takka ta baggara koyroppe akeeka xeellidaappe guye, he taarikiya hanotaa maarayada new xaafoy taw lo77o gidi benttis.
Hessika, ne tamaaridabay tuma gideyssa erisanaassa.
Yihuda kawuwa Heroodisa wode Abbaya yaraappe gidida Zakkariyaasa giya Ayhude kahiney de7ees. Iya machchiyaka Aarona sheeshaappe. I sunthaykka Elsabeexo.
Nam77ayka Godaa woganne kiita ubbaa naagidi borey baynna Xoossaa sinthan xillotethan de7idosona.
Hanoppe attin Elsabeexa maynthi gidida gisho enttaw na7i baawa. Nam77ayka qassi cimidosona.
Issi gallas Zakkariyaasi ba gishuwa maaran Xoossaa sinthan kahinetethan haggaazees.
Kahinetetha wogan Xoossa Keethi gelidi ixaane cuyisanaw iya saami gakkis.
Ixaaney cuya wode asay karen woossees.
Godaa kiitanchchoy yarshshuwa yarshshiya bessaafe ushachcha baggara eqqidi benttis.
Zakkariyaasi iya be7ida wode dagammidi daro yayyis.
Shin kiitanchchoy iyaakko, “Zakkariyaasa yayyofa; ne woosay si7ettis. Ne machchiya Elsabeexa adde na7a yelana, iya Yohaannisa gada ne sunthana.
I new injjenne ufayssi gidana; daroti iya yeletethan ufayttana.
Godaa sinthan I gita gidana woyne ushshaa gidin hara mathoya ushshaa uyenna. Ba aaye ulon de7ishe Geeshsha Ayyaanan kumana.
Isra7eele asatappe darota bantta Godaa, Xoossaakko zaarana.
Aawata wozana naytakko zaarana, kiitettonayssata xillota cinccatethaako zaarana mela, Godaas bessiya dere giigisanaw Eliyaasa ayyaananinne wolqqan Godaa sinthan baana” yaagis.
Zakkariyaasi kiitanchchuwako, “Ta hessa aybin eranee? Taaranne ta machcheera cimida” yaagis.
Kiitanchchoy zaaridi, “Taani Xoossaa sinthan eqqiya Gabreele. Ha mishirachchuwa new odanaw Xoossaafe kiitetas.
Hekko, wodiya naagidi polettiya ta qaala ne ammanonna ixxida gisho, hayssi polettana gakkanaw neeni muume gidana, odettanawukka dandda7akka” yaagis.
He wode Zakkariyaasi Xoossa Keethi gelidi gam77ida gisho, aybi hanide gidi asay karen naagishe gam77is.
I kare keyidi enttana odisanaw dandda7ibeenna. Malli besoppe attin odettanaw dandda7onayssa be7ida wode qonccethi be7idayssa eridosona.
Zakkariyaasi ba haggazuwa polidi soo simmis.
Hessafe guye, iya machchiya Elsabeexa qanthatasu. Ichchashu ageena kumethi bana geenthada gam77asu.
Iya, “Goday ba maarotan ta boriya asaa giddofe digganaw be7idi ha wodiyan hayssa oothis” yaagasu.
Elsabeexa qanthatin usuppuntha ageenan, Xoossay kiitanchchuwa Gabreele Galiila biittan de7iya Naazirete katamaa kiittis.
Kawuwa Dawite sheeshaappe gidida Yoosefa giya uraas oyshettida geela7eekko kiittis. He geela7iya Mayraamo geetettawusu.
Kiitanchchoy iikko bidi, “Daro dosettidare, saroy new gido, Xoossay neera de7ees” yaagis.
Mayraama iya odan daro dagammada, “Hayssi aybi sarotho” gada heetasu.
Kiitanchchoy zaaridi, “Mayraame babbofa; neeni Xoossaa sinthan saba demmadasa.
Hekko neeni qanthatana adde na7a yelana, iya sunthaaka Yesuusa gada sunthana.
I gita gidana, Ubbaafe Bolla Xoossaa na7aa geetetti xeegettana. Godaa Xoossay iya aawa Dawite araata iyaw immana.
I Yayqooba sheeshaa bolla merinaw kawotana; iya kawotethaas zawi baawa” yaagis.
Mayraama kiitanchchuwako, “Hessi waanidi hananee? Ta adde erikke” yaagasu.
Kiitanchchoy zaaridi, “Geeshsha Ayyaanay ne bolla wodhdhana, Ubbaafe Bolla Xoossaa wolqqay ne bolla kuyattana. Hessa gisho, yelettiya geeshsha na7ay Xoossaa Na7aa geetettana.
Hekko, ne dabbiya Elsabeexa ba cimatetha laythan adde na7a qanthatasu. Iya maynthi geetettidaaro, shin ha77i usuppuntha ageena oykkasu.
Xoossaa xooniyabay baawa” yaagis.
Mayraama, “Hekko, taani Godaa aylliw, ne qaalada taw hano” yaagasu. Hessafe guye, kiitanchchoy iippe shaakettis.
Mayraama he saaminttan denddada Yihuda biittan de7iya issi geze katama basu.
Zakkariyaasa soo gelada Elsabeexo sarothasu.
Elsabeexa Mayraami sarothuwa si7ida wode I uluwan de7iya na7ay ufayssan guppis. Elsabeexa Geeshsha Ayyaanan kumada,
ba qaala dhoqqu oothada, “Neeni maccasaa giddofe anjjettidaaro, ne qanthatida na7aykka anjjettidayssa.
Hanoshin, ta Godaa aaye, neeni taakko yaana mela taani oonee?
Hekko ne sarothuwa ta si7ida wode ta uluwan de7iya na7ay ufayssan guppis.
Goday polana gidi immida qaala ammanidaara, iya anjjettidaaro” yaagasu.
Mayraama hayssada yaagasu: “Ta shemppiya Godaa bonchchawusu,
ta Ayyaanay dhaliya Xoossan ufayttees.
I ba aylle kawushshatethaa be7is. Hachchife doomidi yeletethi ubbay tana anjjettidaaro gaana.
Ays giikko, wolqqaama gidida I, taw gitabaa oothis. Iya sunthay Geeshshaa.
Iya bonchcheyssata bolla, iya maarotethay merinaappe merinaa gakkanaassa.
Ba qesiyan minobaa oothis, bantta wozanan otortteyssata laallis.
Wolqqaama kawota araataappe kawushshis; banttana kawushshidayssata kabboys.
Koshattidayssata lo77oban kalssis, shin dureta mela kushe yeddis.
Ba maarota qoppidi, Ba aylliya Isra7eele maaddis.
Hessika nu aawatas odida qaalaa, Abrahamesinne iya sheeshas gidayssa merinaw polanaassa” yaagasu.
Mayraama Elsabeexi matan heedzu ageena mela gam77ada ba soo simmasu.
Elsabeexis yelo qammay gakkin adde na7a yelasu.
I shoorotinne I dabboti Goday gita maarota oothidayssa si7idi, iira issife ufayttidosona.
Hosppuntha gallasan yooga na7a qaxxaranaw yidosona. Iya aawa sunthan Zakkariyaasa gidi sunthanaw koyidosona.
Shin aayiya, “Akkay, Yohaannisa geetettanaw bessees” yaagasu.
Enttika, “Ne dabbotappe ha sunthan xeegettiday oonikka baawa” yaagidosona.
Iya aaway oona gidi sunthaneekko eranaw koyidi iya malla oychchidosona.
I xaafiyabaa oychchi ekkidi, “Iya sunthay Yohaannisa” gidi xaafis. Ubbay I xaafidayssa be7idi malaalettidosona.
Iira Zakkariyaasa inxarssay bilettis, Xoossaa galatishe odetethi oykkis.
Shooroti ubbay yashshan kumidosona. Ha hanidabay geze Yihuda biittan odettis.
Hessa si7ida ubbay, “Ha na7ay ay hananddeshsha” gidi bantta giddon odettidosona. Godaa kushey iyara de7ees.
Yohaannisa aaway Zakkariyaasi Geeshsha Ayyaanan kumidi hayssada yaagidi tinbbite odis.
“Isra7eeliya Goday galatetto, yidi ba asaa wozis.
Ba aylliya Dawite keethan atotethaa kaciya denthis.
Hessika beni wode geeshsha nabeta doonan odettidayssa mela,
Iya ashoy nu morkketappenne nuura eqettiya ubbaa kushiyappe.
Hessa I oothiday nu aawatas ba maarota bessanaasinne, ba geeshsha caaquwa naaganaassa.
Nu aawa Abrahames caaqqida caaquwa qoppanasinne
nu morkketa kusheppe kessidi yashshi baynna iya haggaazana melassa.
Nu laytha ubban geeshshatethaninne xillotethan ba sinthan nuna essanaassa.
Qassi laa na7aw, neeni Ubbaafe Bolla Xoossaa nabe geetettana. Godaa ogiya loythanaw ne iya sinthan baana.
Entta nagaray qushettin, entti atotethi demmanayssa ne Godaa deriyas odana.
Nu Xoossaa lo77o maarotethaafe denddoyssan wontta xalqey nuus saluwappe keyis.
Hessika dhumaninne, hayqo kuya garssan de7eyssatas poo7isanaassa, nu tohuwakka saro ogiyakko zaaranaassa” yaagis.
Na7ay diccis, Ayyaanan minnis, Isra7eele asaas qonccana gakkanaw bazzo biittan de7is.
He wode Roome biittan de7iya asay ubbay taybettana melanne sunthay xaafettana mela kawoy Awugisxoosi kiittis.
Hessika Qerenoosi Soore biittaa aysiya wode oosettida koyro taybuwa.
Hessa gisho, issi issi asi ba sunthaa xaafettanaw ba yelettida biittaa bis.
Yoosefikka Dawite keethaafenne yaraappe gidida gisho, Galiila Naazirete katamaappe denddidi Dawite katama gidida Yihuda Beeteleme bis.
Bishe, yelanaw wodey wurida I oychchi wothida, Mayraamira wolla xaafettanaw bis.
Entti yan de7ishin iw yelo wodey gakkis.
Ba bayra na7aa yelasu. Curqqara xaaxada imathi aqiyason bessi dhayida gisho daran mehe muziya gonggen zin77isasu.
He gadiyan qamma dorssa wudiya naagishe karen aqiya henthanchchoti de7oosona.
Godaa kiitanchchoy hassayonna yidi entta matan eqqis. Godaa bonchchoy entta yuushuwan poo7is; enttika wolqqaama yashshi yayyidosona.
Shin kiitanchchoy, “Yayyofite hekko asaa ubbaas gidiya gita ufayssaa mishirachchuwa ekkada yas.
Hessika, Dawite kataman ashsheyssi hinttew hachchi yelettis. I Godaa Kiristtoosa.
Zoqale na7ay curqqara xaaxettidi gonggen zin77idayssa hintte demmana; hessika hinttew malla gido” yaagis.
Qopponna daro salo kiitanchchoti kiitanchchuwura issife qonccidi,
“Bonchchoy Xoossaas dhoqqa saluwan, saroy biitta bolla Xoossay dosiya asaas gido” yaagidi galatidosona.
Kiitanchchoti enttafe shaakettidi saluwa keyidaappe guye henthanchchoti, “Ane Goday nuus qonccisidabaanne hanidabaa be7anaw Beeteleme boos” yaagidosona.
Enttika ellesidi bidosona. Mayraamo, Yoosefanne zoqale na7aa gonggen zin77idayssa be7idosona.
Be7i simmidi na7abaa enttaw odettoyssa, qonccisidi he bessan de7iya asaas markkattidosona.
Hessa si7ida ubbay henthanchchoti odidayssan malaalettidosona.
Mayraama hanidabaa ubbaa ba wozanan qoppashe de7asu.
Henthanchchoti enttaw odettidayssada hanin be7idosona. Hessa gisho, bantta si7idabaasinne be7idaba ubbaas Xoossaa bonchchishenne galatishe simmidosona.
Hosppuntha qamman, qaxxaro wodey gakkin, I qanthatanaappe sinthe kiitanchchoy wothida sunthan Yesuusa geetettis.
Muse woga mela entta geeshshatetha wodey polettidaappe guye Yoosefaranne Mayraamira yooga na7aa bantta Godaas immanaw Yerusalaame bidosona.
Hessika, Godaa wogan, “Adde gidida bayra na7i ubbay Godaas dummattidayssa gido” geetettidi xaafettidayssa polanaassa.
Qassi Godaa wogan, nam77u kuraachcho woykko holle yarshshanaw efidosona.
He wode geeshshinne ammanora mino gidida Simoona geetettiya asi Yerusalaamen de7ees. I Isra7eeleta atotethaa naagishe de7ees. Geeshsha Ayyaanaykka iya bolla de7ees.
Qassi Kiristtoosa be7onna hayqqonnayssa Geeshsha Ayyaanay iyaw qonccisin eridi de7ees.
I he gallas Ayyaanay kaalethin Xoossa Keethi bis. Na7aa aayeranne aawara wogaa polanaw yooga na7aa Yesuusa ekkidi gelida wode,
Simooni mokki ekkidi na7aa idimmidi,
“Godaw ne taw gelida qaala mela, ha77i ne aylliya saron moyza.
Ta ayfey asaa ubbaa sinthan ne giigisida,
ne ashuwa be7is.
Hessika kawotethata ubbaas, Xoossaa ogiya qonccisiya poo7o, ne asaa Isra7eeleskka bonchcho” yaagidi Xoossaa galatis.
Yoosefaranne Mayraamira iyaw odettidaban malaalettidosona.
Simooni entta anjjis. Aaye Mayraamikko, “Hekko daro asaa wozanaa qofay qonccana mela, Isra7eelen de7iya darotas entta kunddethaasinne dendduwas Xoossan doorettis.
Qassi eqetteyssatas malla gidana. Ne shemppuwarakka qassi mashshi aadhdhana” yaagis.
Qassi Aseere yaraappe gidida Faanu7ela na7iya Haanna geetettiya nabey de7awusu. Iyakka daro cimasu. Iya ba koyro azinaara laappun laythi de7asu.
I azinay hayqqin hosppun tammanne oyddu laythi gidana gakkanaw qammanne gallas pacey baynna woosaninne xooman Xoossa Keethan haggaazasu.
Iya he saatiyan bada Xoossaa galatasu; Yerusalaame wozetethaa naagiya ubbaas yooga na7abaa markkattasu.
Yoosefaranne Mayraamira Godaa higgiyan kiitettida woga ubbaa polidaappe guye Galiila biittan de7iya bantta katama Naazirete simmidosona.
Na7ay diccishenne minnishe bis. Cinccatethan kumis; Xoossaa aadho keehatethay iya bolla de7ees.
Yoosefaranne Mayraamira Faasikka Baale bonchchanaw laythan laythan Yerusalaame boosona.
Yesuusas tammanne nam77u laythi gidiya wode kase meezetidayssada baaliya bonchchanaw bidosona.
Baaliya bonchchidaappe guye soo simmiya wode na7ay Yesuusi Yerusalaamen attis. Shin Yoosefaranne Mayraamira I Yerusalaamen attoyssa eribookkona.
I soo simmiya asaara wolla de7iya daanin entti issi gallasa oge bidosona. I baynnayssa eridaappe guye bantta dabbotanne laggeta matan koyidosona.
I yan dhayin koyishe guye Yerusalaame gakkanaw bidosona.
Heedzu gallasappe guye Xoossa Keethan asttamaareta giddon uttidi enttabaa si7ishenne entta oychchishe de7ishin demmidosona.
Iya si7iya ubbay iya akeekaninne zaaruwan malaalettidosona.
Soo asay iya demmida wode malaalettidosona. Iya aayiyakka, “Ta na7aw, ays nuna hayssada oothadii? Ne aawaranne taara nena koyishe un77ettida” yaagasu.
Yesuusi enttako, “Tana ays koyeetii? Ta, ta aawa keethan daanaw besseyssa erekketii” yaagis.
Shin I enttako gidabaa entti akeekibookkona.
Hessafe guye, enttara issife Naazirete katama bis. Enttaw kiitettishe de7is. Iya aayiya he ubbaa ba wozanan wothada naagasu.
Yesuusi, cinccatethan, geesaninne teematethan Xoossaa sinthaninne asa sinthan diccis.

Kawoy Xibaaryoosi Roome biittan kawotin, tammanne ichchashantho laythan, Phenxe Philaaxoosi Yihuda haariya wode, Heroodisi Galiila haariya wode, iya ishaa Filiphphoosi Ixuuriyasanne Xirakkonddosa haariya wode, Lisaniyoosi Ablaanisa haariya wode,
Hannaranne Qayyafara kahine halaqa gidi de7ishin, Xoossaa qaalay Zakkariyaasa na7aa Yohaannisakko bazzo biittaa yis.
Yohaannisi, “Hintte nagaraappe simmitenne xammaqetite. Xoossay hintte nagaraa atto gaana” yaagidi tamaarssishe Yorddaanose Shaafaa heeran de7iya biitta ubbaa bis.
Hessika nabey Isayaasi ba maxaafan, “Bazzo giddon ba qaala dhoqqu oothidi, waassiya uraa qaalay, ‘Godaa ogiya giigisite, horogaakka piddi oothite.
Aafo ubbay kumana, zumaynne dereynne ziqqi gaana. Wobbe ogey luulana, giigonna horogay qinxi gaana.
Asho ma77ida ubbay, Xoossaa ashuwa be7ana’ ” gidi xaafidayssada hanis.
Yohaannisi, ba kushen xammaqettanaw yida asaakko, “Hinttenoo, shoosha nayto yaanaw de7iya hanquwafe attana mela hinttena zoriday oonee?
Hiza, hintte simuwa qonccisiya lo77o ooso oothite, hintte wozanan, ‘Nuus, nu aaway Abrahamey de7ees gidi ceeqettofite.’ Haa si7ite, ha shuchchatappe Xoossay Abrahames na7a kessanaw dandda7ees.
Hekko, beexey mithaa xaphon de7ees. Hiza, lo77o ayfe ayfonna mitha ubbay qanxettidi taman yegettana” yaagis.
Asay, “Yaatin nuuni ay oothinoo?” yaagidi oychchidosona.
Yohaannisi zaaridi, “Nam77u afili de7iya asi baynnayssas immo. Kathi de7eyssi baynnayssas immo” yaagis.
Qaraxa qanxiseyssati xammaqettanaw yidi, “Asttamaariyaw, nuuni ay oothinoo?” yaagidosona.
I zaaridi, “Hintte qanxisanaw kiitettoyssafe aathidi ekkofite” yaagis.

Qassi wotaaddareti yidi, “Nuuni ay oothinoo” yaagidi oychchidosona. Yohaannisi, “Oodebaakka wolqqan dafidi ekkofite, oonakka worddon mootoppite, hintte damoozey hinttew gido; ufayttidi de7ite” yaagis.
Asay Kiristtoosa naagishe de7iya gisho, Yohaannisa, “I Kiristtoosa gidanddeshshaa?” gidi qoppidosona.

Yohaannisi ubbaas zaaridi, “Taani hinttena haathan xammaqays, shin taappe aadhdhidi wolqqaameyssi yaana. Taani iya caammaa wodoruwa billanaw bessonna asi. I hinttena Geeshsha Ayyaananinne taman xammaqana.
Wudumman de7iya kathaa polo geeshshanaw pithey iya kushen de7ees. Geeshsha kathaa ba shaaliyan qolana; kaliya dhayonna taman xuuggana” yaagis.
Qassi Yohaannisi asaa daro zore zoridi Wonggelaa odis.
Shin Yohaannisi Heroodisi ba ishaa machchiw, Herodiyada, ekkida gishonne haraa iita oosota gisho kaccida wode,
Heroodisi kaseyssa bolla haraba ubbaa gujjidi Yohaannisa woyne gelssis.
Yohaannisi qashettanaappe sinthe asaa ubbaa xammaqidi simmin, Yesuusikka qassi xammaqettis. I woossishin saloy dooyettis.
Geeshsha Ayyaanay holleda benttishe iya bolla uttis. Saloppe “Taani dosiya na7ay nena; ne tana ufayssaasa yaagiya” qaalay yis.

Yesuusi Geeshsha Ayyaanan kumidi Yorddaanose Shaafappe simmida mela Ayyaanay iya bazzo efis.
Yan oytamu gallasinne qamma xalahen paacettis. He gallasatan aykkoka moonna gam77ida gisho wurssethan koshattis.
Xalahey iyaakko, “Neeni Xoossaa na7a gidikko ane hayssi shuchchay uythu gido gada kiitta” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Asi uytha xalaalan deenna geetettidi xaafettis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Xalahey Yesuusa adussa dere bolla kessidi ha alamiya kawotethata ayfe qiphi zaaranaw bessis.
Xalahey, “Ha ubbaas maataynne bonchchoy taw imettis. Taani dosida oodeskka immiya gisho new immana.
Hessa gisho, neeni taw goynniko ubbay new gidana” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Ne Godaa, ne Xoossaa, iya xalaala goynna geetettidi xaafettis” yaagis.
Wurssethan Xalahey Yesuusa Yerusalaame efidi Xoossa Keethas huu7iya bolla essidi, “Neeni Xoossaa na7a gidikko ane duge sa7an nena yegga.
Ays giikko, ‘Nena naagiya Kiitanchchota Xoossay ne gisho kiittana.
Entti ne tohoy shuchchan dhubettonna mela, bantta kushiyan dhoqqu oothidi nena denthana’ geetettidi xaafettis” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Ne Godaa Xoossaa paaccofa geetettidi xaafettis” yaagis.
Xalahey Yesuusa paaciya wurssidaappe guye hara injje wode demmana gakkanaw iyappe shaakettis.
Yesuusi Ayyaana wolqqan kumidi Galiila simmis. Iya sunthay heeran de7iya biitta ubban keyis.
I Ayhude Woosa Keethi gelidi tamaarssis; asay ubbay iya galatidosona.
Yaappe I diccida katamaa Naazirete yis. Kase meezetidayssada Sambbaata gallas Ayhude Woosa Keethi gelis. Nabbabanawukka denddi eqqis.
Nabiya Isayaasa maxaafay iyaw imettin, maxaafaa dooyidi, geetettidi xaafettidayssa demmis:
“Godaa Ayyaanay ta bolla de7ees, manqotas Wonggelaa odana mela Xoossay tana dooris. Qashettidayssatas biletethi, qooqidayssata xeelisanaasinne un77ettidayssata birshshana mela,
Xoossay keehanaw qoppida laythaa odana mela tana kiittis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, maxaafaa xaaxidi haggaazeyssas immidi tamaarssanaw uttis. Ayhude Woosa Keethan de7iya asati ubbay caddi xeellosona.
I, “Hayssi hintte haythan hintte si7iya ha maxaafaa qaalay hachchi polettis” yaagis.
Ubbay iyabaa darssidi odettoosona. Qassi iya doonappe keyaa aadho keehatethan kumida qaalan malaalettishe, “Hayssi Yoosefa na7aa gidenneyye?” yaagidosona.
I, “ ‘Neno dhale aawaw nena ashsha, Qifirnahoomen ne oothidabaa nu si77oyssa qassi hayssan ne kataman ootha’ yaagiya leemisuwan hintte tana gaanayssas sidhey baawa” yaagis.
Qassi, “Tuma odays; nabey ba yelettida biittan bonchchettena.
“Ta hinttew tuma odays; saloy heedzu laythinne bagga gorddettin mino koshi biitta ubban de7iya Eliyaasa wode daro am77eti Isra7eelen de7oosona.
Eliyaasi enttafe issinnekokka kiitettibeenna. Shin Serapitan de7iya am77eeko kiitettis.
Nabiya Elssa7e wode Isra7eelen daro baro hargganchchoti de7oosona. Shin Soore uraa Ni7imaaneppe attin oonikka paxibeenna” yaagis.
Ayhude Woosa Keethan de7iya asay ubbay hessa si7ida wode daro yilotidosona.
Bantta uttida bessaafe denddidi zuma bolla keexettida katamaappe gaxa kessidi sugi yeddanaw aafo doona efidosona.
Shin I entta giddora kanthidi aadhdhis.
Yaappe Galiila biittan de7iya Qifirnahoome katama bis. Yan Sambbaata gallas asaa tamaarssis.
I tamaarssey maatara gidiya gisho ubbay iya timirttiyan malaalettidosona.
Ayhude Woosa Keethan tuna ayyaanay oykkida uray de7ees.
I, “Naazirete Yesuusa nuna ays waaysay nuuppe haakka; neeni yiday nuna dhayssanaaseyye? Neeni ooneekko taani erays. Neeni Xoossaafe yida Geeshsha” yaagidi waassis.
Yesuusi tuna ayyaanaakko, “Si7i gada ha uraappe keya” yaagidi hanqis. Tuna ayyaanay uraa asaa ubbaa sinthan holi yeggidi aykkoka qohonna yeddidi keyis.
Asa ubbay malaalettidosona. Wolikko, “Hanos, hayssi aybi timirtte? Tuna ayyaanata maataninne wolqqan kiittees; enttika keyosona” yaagidosona.
Iya sunthay heera ubban keyis.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi Ayhude Woosa Keethafe keyidi Simoona soo gelis. Simoona machche aayiya mino qoxo misha harggen sakettasu. Iyo pathana mela Yesuusa woossidosona.
I hiixaakko shiiqi hokkidi I harggiya hanqis. Mishay aggin ellesa denddada entta mokkasu.
Away wullana hanishin dumma dumma harggiyan oykettida asaa iyaakko ehidosona. I issuwa issuwa bolla ba kushiya wothidi pathis.
Tuna ayyaanati qassi, “Neeni, Xoossaa na7aa” gidi waassishe daro asaappe keyidosona. Shin I enttana hanqis. I Kiristtoosa gideyssa entti eriya gisho, issibaakka odettonna mela diggis.
Buroo wonttiya wode Yesuusi issi geema bessi bis. Asay koyishe I de7iya bessaa yidosona. Enttafe I shaakettidi boonna mela butetidosona.
Shin I, “Taani hara katamata bada Xoossaa kawotethaa Wonggelaa markkattanaw bessees. Ta kiitettiday hessassa” yaagis.
Yihuda biittan de7iya Ayhude Woosa Keethan sabbakis.
Issi gallas Yesuusi Gensareexe Abbaa matan eqqidashin daro asay iya yuushuwa un77ethidi, I tamaarssiya Xoossaa qaala si7oosona.
Yan nam77u wogolota haatha gaxan de7eyssata be7is. Molo oykkiya asati wogolotappe wodhdhidi bantta gitiya meeccosona.
He wogolotappe Simoonayssan gelidi biittaafe guuthi giddo shiishana mela oychchis. Yaatidi, he wogoluwa bolla uttidi asaa tamaarssis.
Ba tamaarssuwa onggidaappe guye Simoonakko, “Gede ciimmuwako shiishada moluwa oykkanaw hintte gitiya yeggite” yaagis.
Simooni zaaridi, “Asttamaariyaw, qamma kumethaa daaburishe aqidi aykkoka oykkibookko, shin ne giikko gitiya yeggana” yaagis.
Entti gitiya yeggida wode gitey daakettana gakkanaw daro molo oykkidosona.
Hara wogoluwan de7iya bantta laggeti yidi, banttana maaddana mela wuttidi xeegidosona. Entti yidi nam77u wogolota, haathan mitettana gakkanaw molon kunthidosona.
Simoona Phexiroosi hessa be7ida wode Yesuusa sinthan kunddidi, “Godaw, taani nagaranchcho asi gidiya gisho, taappe shaaketta” yaagis.
Hessa I giday inne iyara de7eyssati oykkida moluwa darotethan malaalettida gishossa.
Qassi Simoona lagge gidida Zabdiyoosa nayti Yayqoobaranne Yohaannisara malaalettidosona. Yesuusi Simoonakko, “Babbofa! Hizappe neeni ase oykkiya asi gidana” yaagis.
Entti wogolota gaxa shiishidaappe guye ubbaa aggidi Yesuusa kaallidosona.

Yesuusi katamatappe issuwan de7ishin issi baro harggen oykettida asi he kataman de7ees. He uray Yesuusa be7idi iya sinthan gufannidi, “Godaw, ne shene gidikko tana geeshshanaw dandda7aasa” gidi woossis.
Yesuusi ba kushiya yeddi bochchidi, “Ee, ta shene; geeya” yaagis. Iira baro harggey uraappe kichchis.
Yesuusi, “Hayssa oodeskka odoppa, shin bada nenatethaa Ayhude kahiniya bessa. Ne geeyidayssas markka gidana mela Musey kiittida yarshshuwa yarshsha” gidi kiittis.
Gidoshin, iya sunthay kaseppe aadhdhi dalggishe bis. Daro asay I odiyabaa si7anawunne bantta harggiyafe paxanaw yoosona.
Shin Yesuusi daro wode geema bessi bidi woossees.
Issi gallas Yesuusi tamaarssishin Galiilappenne Yihuda heera ubbaafe qassi Yerusalaameppekka yida Farisaawetinne higge asttamaareti yan uttidosona. Asaa pathiya Godaa wolqqayka iyara de7ees.
He wode asay issi gundda asi halara tookkidi ehidosona. Soo gelssidi iya sinthan wothanaw qoppidosona.
Shin asaa darotethaafe denddoyssan soo gelssanaw xoonettidi keethaa bolla keyidi, kaara qawuxidi, hargganchchuwa halara asaa shaakkidi Yesuusa sinthan yeggidosona.
Yesuusi entta ammanuwa be7idi, “La addiyaw, ne nagaray qushettis” yaagis.
Higge asttamaaretinne Farisaaweti, “Hayssi Xoossaa bolla yaagidi odettey oonee? Issi Xoossaafe attin haray nagara quchchanaw dandda7ey oonee?” yaagidi qoppidosona.
Yesuusi entta qofaa erida gisho enttako, “Hintte wozanan hessatho ays qoppeetii?
‘Ne nagaray qushettis geyssafenne denddada ba geyssafe awussi kawuyii?’
Shin ta hessa giday Asa Na7ay sa7a bolla nagara quchchanaw maati de7eyssa hintte erana melassa.” Hessafe kaallidi, gundda uraakko, “Dendda; ne alggaa tookkada ne soo ba” yaagis.
I ellesi denddidi entta sinthan eqqis I tookettidi yida alggaa tookkidi Xoossaa galatishe ba soo bis.
He wode ubbayka malaalettidosona. Xoossaa galatishe, “Hachchi gita malaata be7ida” yaagidi yashettidosona.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi yaappe keyidi bis. Leewe geetettiya issi qaraxa qanxiseyssi qaraxa qanxisiya bessan uttidayssa be7idi, “Tana kaalla” yaagis.
I ubbabaa aggi denddidi iya kaallis.
He Leewey ba son gita gibira giigisis. Daro qaraxa qanxiseyssatinne hara asati kathaa maanaw uttidosona.
Farisaawetinne higge asttamaareti, “Qaraxa qanxeyssataranne nagaranchchotara ays meetinne uyeetii?” yaagidi Yesuusa tamaareta bolla zuuzummidosona.
Yesuusi enttako, “Hargganchchotassafe attin paxatas aakime koshshenna.
Taani nagaranchchota maarotaakko zaaranaassafe attin geeshshata xeeganaw yabiikke” yaagidi zaaris.
Entti Yesuusakko, “Yohaannisa tamaareti daro wode xoomosona, woossosona; qassi Farisaaweta tamaaretikka hessatho oothoosona. Shin neyssati ubba wode moosonanne uyoosona” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi enttako, “Mushuray enttara de7ishin xeegettida asay xoomana mela oothanaw dandda7etii?
Shin mushuray enttafe shaakettana gallasay yaana, he wode entti xoomana.”
Qassi yaagidi leemiso odis; “Ooratha ma7oppe peedhidi gal77a ma7o bolla sikkey oonikka baawa. Hessatho oothiko ooratha ma7uwa peedhees, oorathay gal77aas giigenna.
Mal7antto woyniya gal77a ogoron qoliya oonikka baawa. Hessa oothiko, ooratha woyney gal77a ogoruwa dhusees; woyney gukkees ogoroykka maaddonabaa gidees.
Hessa gisho, ooratha woyney ooratha ogoron qolettanaw bessees.
Hiza, caalay lo77o giya gisho, caala woyne uyi simmidi mal7antto koyey oonikka baawa” yaagis.
Issi Sambbaata gallas Yesuusi gistte gade giddora aadhdhees. Yesuusa tamaareti tiya bangga duuthidi bantta kushen shirkkidi moosona.
Shin Farisaaweta giddofe issoti issoti, “Sambbaata gallas oothanaw bessonnabaa ays ootheetii?” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi enttako zaaridi, “Dawitey koshattida wode baara de7eyssatara issife oothoyssa nabbabibeekketii?
Xoossa Keethi gelidi Ayhude kahineta xalaalas bessiya daabbuwa mis; baara de7eyssataskka immis” yaagis.
Qassi Yesuusi, “Asa Na7ay Sambbaata Goda” yaagis.
Hara Sambbaata gallas Yesuusi Ayhude Woosa Keethi gelidi tamaarssees. He bessan ushachcha kushey gunddida issi asi de7ees.
Higge asttamaaretinne Farisaaweti iya mootanaw gaaso koyidi Sambbaata gallas pathiko be7ana gidi naagoosona.
Shin Yesuusi entta qofaa eridi kushey gunddida uraakko, “Denddada asaa gidduwan eqqa” yaagis. Uraykka denddi eqqis.
Yesuusi, “Ane ta hinttena issibaa oychchays; Sambbaata gallas oothanaw bessey lo77obayeyye iitabaye? Shemppo ashoyye woykko dhaysso?” yaagis.
Qassi Yesuusi iya yuushuwan de7iya asaa yuushshi xeellidi uraakko, “Ne kushiya piddi ootha” yaagis. Uraykka I gidayssada oothin kushey paxis.
Shin higge asttamaaretinne Farisaaweti daro yilotidosona. Yesuusa bolla ay oothinoo gidi bantta giddon maqettidosona.
He wode gallasatappe issuwan Yesuusi woossanaw deriya bolla keyis. Qamma kumethaa Xoossaa woossishe aqis.
Wonttethe ba tamaareta xeegidi entta giddofe tammanne nam77ata dooris. Enttanakka, “Hawaareta” gidi sunthis.
Enttika, Phexiroosa gidi sunthida Simoona, iya ishaa Inddiriyasa, Yayqooba, Yohaannisa, Filiphphoosa, Bartolomiyoosa,
Maatoosa, Toomasa, Ilfiyoosa na7aa Yayqooba, ba biittaas mishettiya Simoona,
Yayqooba na7aa Yihudanne Yesuusa aathi immida Asqoroota Yihuda.

Yesuusi enttara issife deriyappe wodhdhidi denbba bessan eqqis. Iya tamaaretappe daroti he bessan de7oosona Yihuda biitta ubbaafe Yerusalaameppe, Xiroosappenne Sidoona abbaa gaxappe yida daro asay de7ees.
Entti yiday I tamaarssiyabaa si7anawunne bantta harggiyafe paxanaassa. Tuna ayyaanan waayettiya asatikka paxidosona.
Wolqqay iyappe keyidi asa ubbaa pathiya gisho asay iya bochchanaw koyoosona.
Ba tamaaretakko xeellidi hayssada yaagis: “Hinttenoo, manqoto, hintte anjjettidayssata; Xoossaa kawotethay hinttessa.
Hintte ha77i koshatteyssati anjjettidayssata, hintte kallana. Hintte ha77i yeekkeyssati anjjettidayssata hintte miicana.
Asay hinttena Asa Na7aa gisho, ixxiya wode, hinttena hiliya wode, hinttena entti toochchiya wodenne, iita sunthi entti hinttew immiya wode hintte anjjettidayssata.
“Hekko, hintte woytoy salon gita gidiya gisho he wode ufayssan guppite. Ays giikko, beni entta aawati nabeta bolla hessada oothidosona.”
“Shin dureto hinttena ayye; hintte ha77i lo77o duussaa ekkideta.
Ha77i kallidayssato hinttena ayye; hintte koshattana. Ha77i miiceyssato hinttenoshsho hintte kayottananne yeekkana.
Asi ubbay hintte lo77otethaa xalaala odiya wode hinttena ayye. Entta aawati beni worddanchcho nabeta bolla hessada oothidosona.
“Shin tana si7iya hinttes ta odays; hintte morkketa siiqite hinttena ixxeyssatas lo77obaa oothite.
Hinttena qanggeyssata anjjite, hinttena naaqqeyssatas woossite.
Issi bagga shakalaa baqqeyssas hankko baggaaka bessa. Ne laxana ekkana geyssas ne shaamiziyakka gujjada imma.
Nena woossiya ubbaas imma; neeppe ekkida oonakka zaaro gada oychchofa.
Asay hinttew oothana mela hintte koyabaa ubbaa hintteka asaas oothite.
“Hintte hinttena dosiya asata xalaala dosikko, ay galati hinttew de7ii? Hari attoshin, nagaranchchotikka banttana siiqeyssata siiqoosona.
Hinttew lo77obaa ootheyssata xalaalas lo77obaa oothiko hinttew ay galati de7ii? Nagaranchchotikka hessada oothoosona.
Tal77e zaarana asa xalaalas hintte tal77iko ay dumma galatetteetii? Nagaranchchotikka guye zaarana asi be7idi tal77osona.”

“Shin hintte morkketa siiqite enttaw lo77obaa oothite. Guye ekkanaw qopponna tal77ite. Hessan hintte ekkana woytoy gita gidana. Hintte Ubbaafe Bolla Xoossaa nayta gidana. I bana galatonnayssatasinne iitatas keeha.
Hintte aaway keeha gidoyssada hintteka keeha gidite.
“Asa bolla pirddofite; hintte bolla pirddettenna. Hintte borettonna mela oonakka boroppite. Atto giite; Xoossay hinttew atto gaana.
Immite; hinttew imettana. Hintte makkidaban hinttew zaari makettana, ubbarakka lo77o makkiyaban baqqidi, suuddi kunthidi, laalettana gakkanaw hinttew maketi imettana” yaagis.
Qassika Yesuusi yaagidi enttaw leemiso odis; “Qooqey qooqe kaalethanaw dandda7ii? Kaalethiko nam77ayka woli ekkidi aafon wullokonayye?
Tamaarey asttamaareppe aadhdhenna. Shin loythi tamaarida uray ba asttamaariyatho hanees.
“Ne ishaa ayfiyaan de7iya buuriya ays be7ay? Ne ayfiyaan de7iya tuussi daaneyssa ays be7ikki?

Ne ayfiyaan de7iya tuussi daaneyssa be7onna ne ishaakko, ‘Ta ishaw ne ayfiyaan de7iya buuriya kesso’ gaanaw waana dandda7ey? Neno cubbuwaw, koyrottada ne ayfiyaan de7iya tuussi daaneyssa kessa. Hessafe guye, ne ishaa ayfiyaan de7iya buuriya kessanaw geeshshada xeellana.
“Lo77o mithi iita ayfe ayfenna; hessadakka iita mithi lo77o ayfe ayfena.
Ayfe ayfiyaa mithi ubbay ba ayfiyaan erettees. Agunthafe balase mitha ayfey maxettenna qassi laadeppe woyne ayfey maxettenna.
Lo77o asi ba wozanan kumida lo77obaappe lo77obaa kessees. Iita asi ba wozanan kumida iitabaappe iitabaa kessees. Asi ba wozanan kumidi palahidabaappe ba doonan haasayees.
“Ta geyssa ootheketa, shin yaatin ays tana, ‘Godaw, Godaw, geeti?’
Taakko yeynne ta qaala si7idi poliya ubbay oona daaniyakko ta hinttena bessana.
I keethe keexanaw ziqqi oothi, olla bookkidi, garssan de7iya zaalla bolla keethaa essida cincca uraa daanees. Di7oy di77idi he keethaa sugis, shin minthidi keexida gisho, qaaxxanaw dandda7ibeenna.
Shin ta qaala si7idi oothonay ba keethaa shafe biitta bolla keexida uraa daanees. Di7oy di77idi he keethaa sugida wode ellesidi kunddis. He keethay wolqqaama kunddethi kunddis” yaagis.
Yesuusi hessa ubbaa asaa sinthan tamaarssidi onggidaappe guye, Qifirnahoome giya biittaa bis.
He bessan issi mato halaqay de7ees. I daro dosiya aylley harggettidi hayqos gakkis.
I Yesuusabaa si7ida wode ba aylliya pathana mela iya woosso gidi issi issi Ayhude cimata Yesuusakko kiittis.
Kiitettidayssati, Yesuusakko bidi, “Ne iyaw hayssa oothanaw bessees.
Ays giikko, ha uray nu asaa dosees, Ayhude Woosa Keethaka keexis” gidi minthi woossidosona
Yesuusikka enttara bis. Mato halaqaa sookko matiya wode ba laggeta iyaakko kiittidi, “Godaw, ta kaarappe garssan ne gelanaw ta bessonna gisho, daaburoppa.
Takka tana ne sinthe shiiqanaw bessiya asi gada qoppike. Shin ne issi qaala oda; ta aylley paxana.
Taw taappe bollara halaqay de7ees, taappe garssan ta kiittiya wotaaddareti de7oosona. Issuwa, ‘Ba’ giikko bees, hankkuwa, ‘Haaya’ giikko yees. Ta aylliyakko, ‘Hanno ootha’ giikko oothees” yaagis.
Yesuusi hessa si7ida wode malaalettis. Guye simmidi baara yaa asaakko, “Taani hinttew tuma odays; hari attoshin Isra7eelenkka hayssa mela gita ammano demmabiikke” yaagis.
Kiitettidayssati soo simmiya wode aylley paxin demmidosona.
Guutha wodeppe guye Yesuusi Nayne katamaa bis. Iya tamaaretaranne hara daro asati iyara bidosona.
I katamaa gelana haniya wode aha tookkida daro asati katamaappe keyosona. Hayqqida na7ay ba aayes issuwa, iyakka am77o gidada da7awusu. Katama asaappe daroti iira de7oosona.
Goday iyo be7ida wode qadhettidi, “Yeekkofa” yaagis.
Shiiqidi halaa bochchin tookkida asati eqqidosona. Yesuusi, “La, yalagaw dendda” yaagis.
Hayqqidayssi denddi uttidi oda oykkis. Yesuusi na7aa ekkidi aayes immis.
Asa ubbay yashettidi, “Gita nabey nu giddon denddis; Xoossay ba asaa be7is” yaagidi Xoossaa galatidosona.
Iya sunthay Yihudaninne he heeran de7iya biitta ubban si7ettis.
Xammaqiya Yohaannisa tamaareti hessa ubbaa Yohaannisas odidosona. I entta giddofe nam77ata xeegidi,
“Yaana geetettiday neneyye? Woykko haraa naaginoo?” yaagidi oychchite gidi Godaakko kiittis.
Asati Yesuusakko bidi, Xammaqiya Yohaannisi, “Yaana geetettiday neneyye? Woykko haraa naaginoo?” giite gidi nuna neekko kiittis yaagidosona.
He saatenkka Yesuusi daro asaa harggiyafe pathis. Tuna ayyaanata kessis, qooqida ayfiyakka xeelisis.

Yohaannisa matappe kiitettidi yidayssatakko, “Bidi hintte be7idayssanne si7idayssa Yohaannisas odite. Ayfe qooqeti xeellosona, gunddati birshshettidi hamuttoosona, baro hargganchchoti geeyosona, tulleti si7oosona, hayqqidayssati hayqoppe denddoosona, manqotas Wonggelay sabbakettees.
Tanan dhubettonna oonikka anjjettidayssa.”
Yohaannisi kiittidayssati bidaappe guye Yesuusi asaas Yohaannisabaa yaagidi odis: “Biitta bazzo hintte ay be7anaw keyidetii? Carkkoy qaathiya maata be7anaaseye?
Yaatin, ay be7anaw keyidetii? Kitte ma7o ma77ida asaa be7anaaseyye? Kitte ma7o ma77idayssatinne sa7i injjetida asay kawo keethan de7oosona.
Yaatin, ay be7anaw keyidetii? Nabiya be7anaaseye? Ee, ta yaagays: hintte be7anaw keyiday nabeppe aadhdheyssa.
‘Ne ogiya ne sinthan giigisiya ta kiitanchchuwa neeppe sinthe ta kiittana’ geetettidi xaafettiday iyassa.
Ta hinttew odays; maccasappe yelettidayssata giddofe Yohaannisappe aadhdhey baawa. Xoossaa kawotethan ubbaafe guuxeyssi, I ubbaafe gita gidana” yaagis.
Hari attoshin, Yesuusa qaala si7ida qaraxa qanxiseyssati ubbay Yohaannisa kushen xammaqettidi Xoossay xillo gideyssa qonccisidosona.
Shin Farisaawetinne higge asttamaareti Yohaannisa kushen xammaqettonna ixxidi Xoossaa zoriya leqisidosona.
Yesuusi kaallidi hayssada yaagis: “Hiza, ha wodiya yeletethaa aybira daaniso? Enttika oona daanoona?
Giya giddon uttidi woli xeegidi, ‘Nu hinttew suusul77e punnin, hintte yexxeketa. Nu sabbidi zeleelin, hintte yeekkeketa’ yaagiya nayta daanosona.
Xammaqiya Yohaannisi moonnanne uyonna yin, ‘Iita ayyaanara de7ees gideta.’
Asa Na7ay mishenne uyishe yin, ‘Yarambbanne ushanchcho, qaraxa qanxiseyssatanne nagaranchchota dabbo’ gideta.
Hiza, cinccatethaa tumatethay iya nayta ubbaa matan erettis” yaagis.
Issi Farisaawey Yesuusa kathi muzanaw ba soo xeegis. I Farisaawiya soo bidi gayta bolla uttis.
He kataman issi nagaranchcho maccasi de7iyara Yesuusi Farisaawiya son gibira bolla de7eyssa si7ida wode daro al77o philqqaaxe shitto ekkada yasu.
Yesuusas guye baggara, iya tohuwa matan eqqada yeekkashe iya tohuwa ba afuthaara laakethawsu. Ba binaanara iya tohuwa quchchashenne yeerashe shitto tiyasu.
Gibira giigisida Farisaawey hessa be7ida wode ba wozanan, “Hayssi nabe gidiyakko ha maccasiya iya bochchiyara ooneekko qassi iya nagaranchcho gideyssakka I eranashin” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Simoona, ta new odiyabay de7ees” yaagis. I, “Asttamaariyaw, taw oda” yaagis.
Yesuusi iyaakko, “Nam77u asati issi uraappe miishe tal77idosona. Issoy ichchashu xeetu bira hankkoy qassi ishatamu bira tal77idosona.
Nam77ayka tal77iya cigganaw xoonettin, nam77ataskka tal77iya maaris. Hiza, ha nam77atappe he uraa daro dosanay new awussa daanii” yaagis.
Simooni, “Daro acoy maarettida uray daro dosana daanees” yaagis. Yesuusi, “Ne tuma pirddadasa” yaagis.

Hessafe guye, Yesuusi maccaseekko simmi xeellidi, Simoonakko, “Hanno maccasiw be7ay? Taani ne soo gelin hari attin ne taw toho haathe immabaakka, shin iya ta tohuwa ba afuthan laakothada ba binaanan quchchasu.
Neeni tana yeera ekkabaakka, shin iya ta ne soo geloodeppe doomada ta tohuwa yeero aggabukku.
Neeni ta huu7iyan zayte tiyabaka, shin iya ta tohuwa shitto tiyawusu.
Iya tana daro dosida gisho I daro nagaray atto geetettis. Iya guutha nagaray atto geetettiday guuthara dosees.”
Yesuusi maccaseekko, “Ne nagaray atto geetettis” yaagis.
Iyara issife gaytan uttidi miya imathati, “Nagara atto yaagey, I hayssi oonee?” yaagidi bantta wozanan qoppidosona.
Yesuusi maccaseekko, “Ne ammanoy nena ashshis; saro ba” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi Xoossaa kawotethaa Wonggelaa sabbakishe katamaaranne gutaara aadhdhis. He wode tammanne nam77u hawaareti iyara de7oosona.
Qassi tuna ayyaanaappenne dumma dumma harggiyafe paxida issi issi maccasati iyara de7oosona. Enttika, laappun tuna ayyaanati keyida Magdela Mayraamo,
Heroodisa shuumaa Kuuza machchiw Yohaanna, Soosinnaranne qassi hara daroti enttana miishen maaddeyssati de7oosona.
Daro asay dumma dumma katamaappe iyaakko shiiqin leemison enttaw odis.
“Issi goshshanchchoy zerethi zeranaw keyis. I zerishin issi issi zerethay oge gaxan wodhdhidi yedhdhettis, salo kafoti maxidosona.
Harati shaalloy garssan de7iya biitta bolla wodhdhidosona. Buroo dolida mela biittan laahoy baynna gisho miccidosona.
Hara zerethay qassi aguntha giddon wodhdhis. Agunthaara wolla diccida gisho agunthay cuullidi bessan ashshis.
Harati lo77o biitta bolla wodhdhidosona. Dolida wode xeetu kushe ayfidosona.” Hessa odi onggidi, ba qaala dhoqqu oothidi, “Si7iya haythi de7iya ubbay si7o” yaagis.
Iya tamaareti, “Ha leemisuwa birshshethay aybee?” yaagidi oychchidosona
I, “Xoossaa kawotethaa xuuraa erana mela hinttew imettis. Shin harati be7ishe demmonna mela, si7ishe akeekonna mela leemison odays.
“Hiza, ha leemisuwa birshshethay hayssa: zerethi yaagettiday Xoossaa qaala.
Oge gaxan wodhdhida zerethay qaala si7eyssata. Gidoshin, entti ammanidi attonna mela Xalahey qaala entta wozanaappe maxi digees.
Shaalloy garssan de7iya biitta bolla wodhdhida zerethay qaala si7idi ufayssan ekkeyssata. Entti ha77is ammanoosonappe attin xaphoy baynna gisho paacey gakkiya wode ellesidi kaddoosona.
Aguntha giddon zerettidayssati qaala si7eyssata. Enttika alamiya qofan, duretethaaninne sa7aa duussaa miikkotethan cuulettidi besseyssada ayfibookkona.
Lo77o biittan wodhdhida zerethay lo77o wozanan qaala si7idi naageyssatanne dandda7an minnidi ayfe ayfeyssata.
“Xomppe xomppidi, daachcho kammey woykko arssafe garssan wothey deenna. Geliya asi be7ana mela dhoqqa bessan wothees.
“Hessa gisho, qoncce keyonna qosettidi attiyaabay, erettonna geemmidi attiyaabay deenna.
“Hiza, hintte qaala waati si7iyakko akeekite. De7iya ubbaas guzhetidi imettana, baynnayssas hari attoshin iyaw de7iya guuthiyaka iyappe ekettana” yaagis.
Yesuusa aayeranne ishatara iyaakko yidosona. Shin asaa darotethaafe denddoyssan iya demmanaw dandda7ibookkona.
Issi asi Yesuusakko, “Ne aayeranne ne ishatara nena koyidi karen naagoosona” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Xoossaa qaala si7idi qaala ooson peeshsheyssati ubbay taw aayonne taw isha” yaagis.
Issi gallas Yesuusaranne iya tamaaretara issife wogolon gelidi, “Abbaa pinnoos” yaagis. Enttika baanaw denddidosona.
Abbaa bollara entti pinnanaw bishin Yesuusi dhiskkis. Qopponna mino carkkoy abbaa bolla denddis. Haathay wogoluwan gelin wogoloy mitetethi oykkiya wode ubbay babbidosona.
Iya tamaareti iyaakko shiiqidi, “Nu Godaw, nu Godaw, nu dhayos yaagidi” Yesuusa denthidosona. Yesuusi denddidi carkkuwanne gotiya seeris. Ellesidi carkkoynne gotey woppu gis. Sarotethayka simmis.
Yesuusi ba tamaaretakko, “Hintte ammanoy awunee” yaagis. Enttika, yayyishenne malaalettishe issoy issuwako, “Carkkoynne haathay kiitetteyssi, I hayssi oonee” yaagidosona.
Abbaa pinnidi Galiila baggara de7iya Gerggesoone biittaa gakkidosona.
Yesuusi wogoluwappe keyidi sa7an wodhdhishin tuna ayyaanan oykettida uray katamaappe keyidi iyara gayttis. Daro laythi afili ma77onna kallo duufon de7eesippe attin soo gelenna.
Yesuusa be7ida wode iya sinthan gufannidi, ba qaala dhoqqu oothidi, “Ubbaafe Bolla Xoossaa na7aw Yesuusa neera taw aybi issifetethi de7ii? Hayyana tana ha77i un77ethofarkkii” yaagis.

Hessa I giday, tuna ayyaanay uraappe keyana mela Yesuusi hanqettida gishossa. Daro wode tuna ayyaanay iya haarida gisho santhalaataninne toho qachchiya biraatan qashettidi naagettees. Shin qashuwa duuthidi tuna ayyaanan laagettidi bazzo gelis.
Yesuusi, “Ne sunthay oonee” yaagidi oychchis. I, daro tuna ayyaanati iya oykkidi gisho bana, “Leegiyona” gis.
Tuna ayyaanati banttana Si7oole kiittonna mela woossidosona.
He bessan zooze bolla miya guduntho wudey hamuttees. Hini gudunthotan gelino gidi woossidosona, ikka ‘Gelite’ gis.
Tuna ayyaanati uraappe keyidi gudunthotan gelidosona. Wudey deriyappe duge gurgguxidi abban gelis.
Henthanchchoti hanidayssa be7ida wode woxxi bidi, katamaninne guta ubban odidosona.
Asay hanidabaa be7anaw keyidi Yesuusakko yidosona. Tuna ayyaanay keyida uray ma7o ma77idi, iya wozanay simmin, Yesuusa toho matan uttidayssa demmidi yayyidosona.
Iya be7ida asay tuna ayyaanan oykettida uray waanidi paxidaakko odidosona.
Gerggesoone yuushuwan de7iya asay gita yashshi yashettidi Yesuusi bantta matappe baana mela woossidosona. I wogoluwan gelidi guye simmis.
Tuna ayyaanay keyida uray Yesuusara daanaw woossis.
Shin Yesuusi iyaakko, “Ne soo simma, Xoossay ay mela gitabaa new oothidaakko oda” yaagidi mooyzis. Uraykka Yesuusi ay mela gitabaa iyaw oothidaakko katama ubban markkattishe bis.
Asay naagidi gam77ida gisho Yesuusi simmiya wode mokki ekkidosona.
Ayhude Woosa Keetha halaqa gidida Iyaroosa giya uray ba soo yaana mela Yesuusa tohuwa bolla wodhdhidi woossis.
Iyaw tammanne nam77u laythi gidida macca na7a de7iyara sakettada hayqos gakkada de7awusu. Yesuusi biya wode asay iya un77ethees.
Tammanne nam77u laythi suuthi goggishe gam77ida maccasi de7iyara de7awusu. Iya baw de7iya miishiya aakimetas immada onggasu. Shin paxanaw dandda7abukku.
Iya Yesuusas guye baggara shiiqada, iya afilaa macaraa bochchasu, sohuwara goggiya suuthay eqqi aggis.
Yesuusi, “Tana bochchiday oonee?” yaagis. Ubbay ‘Nu bochchibookko’ yaagin, Phexiroosi, “Asttamaariyaw, daro asay kaallishininne un77ethishin be7ashe waanada, ‘Tana bochchiday oonee?’ gay” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi, “Issi asi tana bochchis; ays giikko, wolqqi taappe keyoyssi taw erettis” yaagis.
Maccasiya, ibay qonccidayssa erida wode kokkorashe yada Yesuusa tohuwa bolla kunddasu. Ays bochchidaakkonne waanada ellesada paxidaakko asaa ubbaa sinthan markkattasu.
I, “Ta naatte ne ammanoy nena pathis; saron ba” yaagis.
Yesuusi oda onggonna de7ishin, Ayhude Woosa Keetha halaqaa, Iyaroosa sooppe issi asi yidi, “Iyaroosa, ne na7iya hayqqasu; asttamaariya mela daaburissofa” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi hessa si7idi Iyaroosakko, “Babbofa! Ammana, ne na7iya paxana” yaagis.
Yesuusi Iyaroosa soo gakkida wode Phexiroosappe, Yohaannisappe, Yayqoobappe, na7ee aawappenne aayeppe attin hari gelana mela koyibeenna.
He bessan de7iya asa ubbay na7ees mishettidi yeekkishin, Yesuusi, “Yeekkofite! Na7iya dhiskkasuppe attin hayqqabuukku” yaagis.
Asay na7iya hayqqidayssa eriya gisho, iya oda leqqidi miicidosona.
Shin Yesuusi na7ee kushiya oykkidi, “Naatte dendda” yaagis.
Na7ees shemppoy simmin dendda eqqasu. Yesuusi enttako, “Iwu miyabaa immite” yaagis.
Na7ee aawaranne aayera malaalettidosona. Shin Yesuusi hayssa, “Oodeskka odoppite” yaagis.
Yesuusi tammanne nam77u hawaareta baakko xeegidi, tuna ayyaanata kessana melanne hargge ubbaa pathana mela wolqqanne maata immis.
Xoossaa kawotethaabaa markkattanaadanne hargganchchota pathanaada kiittis.
I enttako, “Xam77a gidin ogoro gidin kathi gidin miishe gidin laammi ma77iya afila gidin oges gidi aykkoka oykkofite.
He katamaappe hintte keyana gakkanaw imathatethan hintte gelidasuwan gam77ite.
Oonikka hinttena mokkonna ixxiko he katamaappe keyishe enttaw markka gidana mela hintte tohuwan de7iya bana pittidi keyite.”
Enttika kiitettidayssada keyidi Wonggelaa odishenne dumma dumma gutatan hargganchchota pathishe aadhdhidosona.
Galiila biittaa haariya Heroodisi Yesuusi oothidabaa ubbaa si7ida wode dagammis. Ays giikko, issi issi asati Yohaannisi hayqoppe denddonna aggenna yaagosona.
Baggati, “Eeliyaasi qonccis” goosona; harati qassi, “Beni nabetappe issoy hayqoppe denddis” yaagidi odettoosona.
Shin Heroodisi, “Yohaannisa qoodhiya ta qanxisada wodhas. Yaatin, hayssatho yaagettidi iyabaa odettey, I oonee?” yaagidi ba ayfen be7anaw koyees.
Tammanne nam77u hawaareti guye simmi yidi, entti oothidabaa ubbaa Yesuusas odidosona. I enttana ekkidi Beetesayda katamaappe gaxa efis.
Shin daro asay Yesuusa gideyssa eridi iya kaallidosona. I entta mokki ekkidi Xoossaa kawotethaabaa tamaarssis; paxanaw koyeyssatakka pathis.
Sa7i omarssiya wode tammanne nam77u hawaareti iyaakko shiiqidi, “Nu de7ey bazzo biitta gidiya gisho asay dumma dumma gutatanne katamata bidi, kathinne aqiyaso koyana mela asaa moyza” yaagidosona.
Shin I, “Enttaw miyabaa hintte immite” yaagis. Entti, “Nuus de7ey ichchashu uythinne nam77u molo gidiya gisho, ha asaas gidiya kathi nuuni bidi shammonna ixxiko gidenna” yaagidosona.
He bessan ichchashu mukulu gidiya addeti de7oosona. Yesuusi ba tamaaretakko, “Ishataman ishataman shaakki shaakki asaa utisite” yaagis.
Iya tamaareti, I kiittidayssada asaa utisidosona.
I ichchashu uythaanne nam77u molota ekkidi, salo xeellidi, Xoossaa galatidi, meenthidi asaa ubbaa gathana mela ba tamaaretas immis.
Ubbay midi kallidosona. Enttafe attida tiifey tammanne nam77u gayta kumethi gidis.
Yesuusi ba xalaala woossishin, iya tamaareti iyaakko yidosona. I, “Asay tana oona goonaa?” gidi oychchis.
Entti zaaridi “Issoti issoti, ‘Xammaqiya Yohaannisa, baggati Eliyaasa, harati qassi, beni nabetappe issoy hayqoppe denddis’ yaagosona” yaagidosona.
I zaaridi, “Yaatin hintte tana oona geeti” yaagis. Phexiroosi, “Neeni Xoossaafe kiitettida Kiristtoosa” yaagidi zaaris.
Yesuusi hayssa oodeskka odoppite gidi minthidi odis.
Qassika Yesuusi, “Asa Na7ay daro metuwa ekkana. Biitta cimatan, kahine halaqatan, higge asttamaaretan aadhdhi imettana. Entti iya wodhana, shin I heedzantho gallas hayqoppe denddana” yaagis.
Yesuusi asaa ubbaako, “Tana kaallanaw koyey oonikka de7ikko bana kaddo, ba masqaliya gallas gallas tookkidi tana kaallo.
Ba shemppiw ashshanaw koya ubbay iyo dhayssees, ba shemppiw ta gisho gidi dhayssiya oonikka iyo ashshees.
Asi alame ubbaa haaridi, gidoshin ba shemppiw dhayssiyabaa woykko qohiyabaa gidikko iya ay maaddii?
Oonikka tananinne ta qaalan yeellatikko Asa Na7ay ba bonchchuwara hessadakka aawa bonchchuwaranne Geeshsha kiitanchchota bonchchuwara yaa wode iyan yeellatana.
Ta hinttew tuma odays; hayssan eqqidayssata giddofe Xoossaa kawotethaa be7onnashin hayqqonna asati de7oosona” yaagis.
Yesuusi he oda odin, hosppun gallasappe guye, Phexiroosa, Yayqoobanne Yohaannisa baara ekkidi woossanaw deriya bolla keyis.
I woosa bolla de7ishin iya ayfe karey laamettis; afilaykka awa mela phoolidi booxis.
Nam77u asati, enttika Museranne Eliyaasara bonchchon qonccidi,
Yerusalaamen polettanaw de7iyabaa, hessika, I ha alamiyappe shaakettanabaa iyara odettoosona.
Phexiroosanne iyara de7eyssata dhiskkoy efin, entti dhiskkofe barkkiya wode iya bonchchuwanne iyara eqqida nam77u asata be7idosona.

Asati Yesuusappe shaakettidi baana hanishin, Phexiroosi Yesuusakko, “Godaw, hayssan gideyssi nuus ay mela lo77o! Issino new, issino Muses, issino Eliyaasas oothidi heedzu shaqara shaqaroos” yaagis. Shin I ay odettidaakko erenna.
I yaagidi odettishin shaaray yidi enttana kammis. Entti he shaara giddo gelishe babbidosona.
Shaara giddofe, “Ta doorida na7ay hayssa iya si7ite” yaagiya qaalay si7ettis.
He qaalay si7ettidaappe guye, Yesuusi barkka de7ishe benttis. He wode entti be7idabaa oodeskka odonna, bantta wozanan oykkidi si7i gidosona.
Wonttethe entti deriyappe wodhdhiya wode daro asay yidi iyara gayttidosona.
He wode asaa giddofe issi asi, “Asttamaariyaw, ta issi na7aa yada be7arkki.
Tuna ayyaanay qopponna oykkidi waasises; goppontto yegisidi qakerethees, asatethaa qohidi un77ethidi yeddees.
Ne tamaareti kessana mela woossas, shin entti dandda7ibookkona” yaagidi woossis.
Yesuusi, “Ammanoy baynna geella yeletethato, awude gakkanaw ta hinttera daane, hinttena dandda7anee? Ne na7aa bada haa ekkaya” yaagis.
Na7aa ekkidi yaa wode tuna ayyaanay sa7an holi yeggidi kokkorssis. Shin Yesuusi tuna ayyaanaa hanqidi na7aappe kessis. Na7aakka na7aa aawas immis.
Asay ubbay Xoossaa gita wolqqan malaalettidosona. Entti I oothidaban malaalettishin, Yesuusi ba tamaaretakko,
“Hayssa ta hinttew odeyssa loythi si7ite; Asa Na7ay morkketa kushen aadhdhi imettana” yaagis.
Shin I gidabay enttafe geemmida gisho, akeekibookkona. Hessa gisho, zaaridi oychchanaw babbidosona.
Yesuusa tamaareti, “Nu giddon gita gidanay oonee?” gidi palama oykkidosona.
Yesuusi entta wozanaa qofaa eridi yooga na7aa ba matan essidi,
“Ha yooga na7aa ta sunthan mokkiya oonikka tana mokkees, tana mokkey tana kiittidayssa mokkees, hintte ubbaafe guuxeyssi, I gita gidana” yaagis.
Yohaannisi, “Godaw, issi asi ne sunthan tuna ayyaanata kessishin be7idi I nuura gidonna gisho diggida” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Hinttera eqettonnayssi, I hintte bagga. Hessa gisho, iya diggofite” yaagis.
Yesuusi salo biya wodey matattida gisho, Yerusalaame baanaw qanxidi denddis.
Samaare biittan de7iya issi gutaa bidi, ubbabaa iyaw giigisana mela ase yaa kiittis.
Shin I bey Yerusalaame gidiya gisho, entti iya mokki ekkibookkona.
Yesuusa tamaareti Yayqoobaranne Yohaannisara hessa be7idi, “Godaw, saloppe tami wodhdhidi entta mo gaana mela ne koyay” yaagidosona.
Shin Yesuusi guye simmi entta hanqettidi, “Hintte garssan aybi ayyaani de7iyakko hintte erekketa. Asa Na7ay ase ashshanaw yisippe attin dhayssanaassa gidenna” yaagis.
Yaappe denddidi hara guta bidosona.
Entti ogiyara bishin, issi asi, “Ne biyaso ubbaa ta kaallana” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Workkanatas olli, salo kafotas keethi de7ees, shin Asa Na7ay ba huu7iya shemppisiyasoy baawa” yaagis.
Hankkuwako, “Neeni tana kaalla” yaagis. Shin uray, “Godaw, koyrottada ta aawa moogada yaana” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi, “Hayqqidayssati hayqqidayssata moogana mela enttaw aggaaga; neeni bada Xoossaa kawotethaa sabbaka” yaagis.
Qassi hara asi, “Godaw, ta nena kaallana, shin koyrottada ta soo asa sarothada yaana” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Koxe oykkidi guye xeelliya oonikka Xoossaa kawotethaas bessenna” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Goday haraa laappun tammanne nam77u asata dooris. I baanaw qoppida katamaanne guta ubbaa sinthattidi baanada nam77a nam77a oothidi kiittis.
Yesuusi enttako, “Hekko shiiqana kathay daro shin oosanchchoti guutha. Yaaniya gisho, kathaa goday oosanchchota kiittana mela woossite.
Hiza, biite, dorssatada suudhumeta giddo hinttena taani yeddana.
Hintte biya ogiyas aykkoka oykkofite, miishe gidin kathi gidin caamma oykkofite. Oge bolla oonakka sarothofite.
Hintte gelida keethaa ubbaa koyrottidi, ‘Saroy ha keethaas gido’ yaagite.
Saro dosiya asi he bessan de7ikko, hintte saroy yan shemppana; ixxas giikko hintte saroy hinttew simmana.
Oosanchchos damooze bessiya gisho, hintte gelida keethan hinttew shiishidayssa ubbaa mishenne uyishe yan gam77ite. Issuwa sooppe issuwa soo yuuyoppite.
Ay katamakka hintte geliya wode asay hinttena mokkidi, hinttew shiishidaba ubbaa miite.
He kataman de7iya hargganchchota pathishe, ‘Xoossaa kawotethay hintteko matis’ yaagidi odite.
Shin issi katamaa geliya wode asay hinttena mokkonna ixxiko dabaaba keyidi hayssada giite:
‘Nu tohuwa bolla de7iya hintte katamaa baana pittoos, shin Xoossaa kawotethay hintteko matattidayssa erite.’
Pirdda gallasan ha katamaappe Soodome katamaas pirdday kawushshe gidanayssa ta hinttew odays” yaagis.

Kaallidikka, Yesuusi, “Neno Koraaziine, neno Beetesayda, ayye, hinttenan oosettida malaatati Xiroosaninne Sidoonan oosettidaakko yan de7iya asay kayo ma7o ma77idi, bidintha bolla uttidi beni maarotan geli agganashin.
Hessa gisho, hinttefe aathidi Xiroosasinne Sidoonas Xoossaa pirdday kawuyana.
Nekka Qifirnahoome, salo gakkanaw nena dhoqqu oothanaw koyay? Ne duge Si7oole holettana” yaagis.
Qassika Yesuusi ba tamaaretakko, “Hinttena si7ey tana si7ees, hinttena ekkonnay tana ekkena, tana ekkonnay tana kiittidayssa ekkenna” yaagis.
Laappun tammanne nam77u tamaareti kiitettida bessaafe keehi ufayttishe simmidosona. Yesuusakko shiiqidi, “Godaw, ne sunthan tuna ayyaanatikka nuus kiitettidosona” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi enttako, “Xalahey saloppe wol77anthada wodhdhishin ta be7as.
Hekko, shooshaanne kornne yedhdhana melanne morkkiya wolqqaa zaarana mela maata hinttew immas. Hinttena qohanabay aykkoyka deenna.
Gidoshin, hintte sunthay salo mazggaban xaafettida gisho, ufayttiteppe attin tuna ayyaanati kiitettida gisho ufayttofite” yaagis.

He wode Yesuusi Geeshsha Ayyaanan ufayttidi, “Saluwa sa7aa Godaw, hayssa cinccatappenne eranchchotappe geenthada yalagatas qonccisida gisho galatetta. Ee ta aawaw, hessa ne oothanaw lo77o shene gidis.
“Ubbabay ta aawappe taw imettis. Na7ay ooneekko aawappe attin hari woykko na7ay qonccisanaw koyeyssafe hari oonikka aawa erey baawa” yaagis.
Kaallidikka, Yesuusi dumma ba tamaaretakko, “Hintte be7eyssa be7eyssati anjjettidayssata.
Tuma daro nabetinne kawoti hintte be7eyssanne si7eyssa be7anawunne si7anaw amottidosona, shin be7ibookkona, si7ibookkona” yaagis.
Hekko, issi gallas Muse wogaa eriya issi uray denddidi Yesuusa yaagidi paace oysho oychchis. “Asttamaariyaw, merinaa de7uwa laattanaw taani ay ootho?” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Muse maxaafan xaafettiday woygii? Ne waata nabbabay?” yaagis.
Addey zaaridi, “ ‘Ne Godaa ne Xoossaa, ne kumetha wozanappe, ne kumetha shemppuwafe, ne kumetha wolqqaafenne ne kumetha qofaappe dosa. Qassi ase ne shooruwa ne huu7iyada dosa’ yaagees” yaagis.
Yesuusi iyaakko, “Neeni likke zaaradasa, nekka hessada ootha. Neeni merinaw de7on daana” yaagis.
Shin uray bana xillo oothanaw koyidi, “Hanos I ta shooroy oonee?” yaagis.

Iya oyshaas Yesuusi yaagidi zaaro immis, “Issi ase de7eyssi Yerusalaame katamaappe duge Iyaarkko katamaa bishin oge bolla panggati keyidi shocidosona. Iya ma7uwa qaari ekkidi hayqoppenne paxappe giddon yeggidi bidosona.
Guyeppe, Ayhude kahine issoy he ogiyara ba buussu bishe uraa be7idi deshshi gidi aadhdhis.
Qassi issi Leewe de7eyssi he bessaa gakkishe uraa be7idi harasoora aadhdhidi bis.
Shin, issi Samaare biitta ase de7eyssi he ogiyara yishe uraa be7idi iyaw qadhettis
Iyaakko shiiqidi, iya madunthaa bolla zaytenne woyne tigidi qachchis. Ba hariya bolla utisidi imathi aqiya keethi efis. He bessan iyaw koshshiyaba ubbaa oothis.
Wonttethe nam77u dinaare kessidi imatha keethaawas immidi, ‘Hayyana ha uraa loytha xeella. Taani new immidayssafe bollara ne kessiyabaa ubbaa ta new ciggana’ yaagis.
“Hiza, ha heedzu asatappe panggati shocida uraas shoorotey new oona daanii?”
Uray zaaridi, “Iyaw qadhettidayssaka” yaagis. Yesuusi, “Nekka bada hessada ootha” yaagis.
Yesuusi ba tamaaretara oge bishe issi guta gakkis. Yan Martta geetettiya issi maccasiya iya ba son mokkasu.
Iwukka Mayraamo giya michchiya de7awusu, Mayraama qaala si7ashe Godaa tohuwa matan uttasu.
Shin Martta daro ooson un77ettada Yesuusakko shiiqada, “Godaw, ta michchiya oosuwa ta xalaalas yeggada utta aggin ta daaburiya wode neeni be7ashe si7i gay? Iya tana maaddana mela odikkii” yaagasu.
Shin Goday hayssada gidi zaaris, “Martta, Martta, neeni daroban un77ettasaanne metootasa.
Gidoshin, koyettey issibaa xalaala. Mayraama lo77o doorasu, hessika iippe ekettenna” yaagis.
Issi gallas Yesuusi issi bessan woossees. Woosaa wurssida wode iya tamaaretappe issoy, “Godaw, Yohaannisi ba tamaareta woosa tamaarssida mela nekka nuna woosa tamaarssa” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Hayssada yaagidi woossite: ‘Saluwan de7iya nu aawaw ne geeshsha sunthay anjjetto; ne kawotethay yo.
Nu gallasa kathaa hachchi hachchi nuus imma.
Nuna qoheyssata nuuni atto geyssada, nu nagara atto ga; paacen nuna gelssofa’ yaagite” yaagis.
Kaallidikka, Yesuusi ba tamaaretakko yaagis: “Leemisos hinttefe issuwas laggey de7ees. I giddi bilahe ba laggiya soo bidi, ‘Ta laggiyaw, guutha uythi taw immarkki.
Taw lagge gidida issi asi ogeppe yin, iyaw aathiyabaa dhayas’ yaagikko,
“Iya laggey keethaa giddon gididi, ‘Hayyana tana waaysoppa, wulay gorddettis. Ta naytikka taara arssa bolla zin77idosona. Yaaniya gisho, denddada ne koyabaa immanaw dandda7ikke’ yaagiyye?
Ta hinttew odays; laggetethaa gisho denddidi immanaw koyonna ixxikokka woosan salethida gisho denddidi koshshiyaba ubbaa immees.
“Hessa gisho, taani hinttew odays: woossite hinttew imettana; koyite hintte demmana; kare yidi xeegite hinttew dooyettana.
Gaasoykka woossiya ubbay ekkees; koyey demmees; kare yidi xeegeyssas dooyettees.
“Hinttenoo, aawato hintte giddofe na7i uythi woossin shuchchu immey oonee? Molo woossin shooshi immey oonee?
Woykko phuuphphulle woossiko kornne immi?
Hintte iitata gidishe hintte naytas lo77obaa immo erikko, salon de7iya hintte aaway woosseyssatas Geeshsha Ayyaana waati aathi immenne?” yaagis.
Issi gallas Yesuusi doona muumisida tuna ayyaanaa issi uraappe kessis. Tuna ayyaanay keyida mela muume uray odettis. Asaykka malaalettis.
Shin issoti issoti, “Tuna ayyaanaa halaqaa, Bi7elzebuula wolqqan tuna ayyaanata kessees” yaagidosona.
Harati qassi paaces saloppe malla bessana mela koyidosona.
Shin Yesuusi entta qofaa eridi enttako, “Woli giddon shaakettiya kawotethi ubbay dhayees; woli giddon shaakettiya keethi kunddees.
Xalahey woli giddon shaakettiko iya kawotethay waanidi minnidi eqqanee? Hintte tana, ‘I tuna ayyaanata Bi7elzebuula wolqqan kessasa’ yaageta.
Hiza, taani tuna ayyaanaa Bi7elzebuula wolqqan kessiyabaa gidikko hintte nayti oode wolqqan kessonashsha? Hessa gisho, entti hintte bolla pirddeyssata gidana.
Shin taani tuna ayyaanati Xoossaa biradhdhen kessiyabaa gidikko hiza Xoossaa kawotethay hintteko matidayssa erite.
“Mino asi danccettidi ba keethaa naagiyabaa gidikko, iya shaloy boshettenna.
Hanoshin, iyappe aadhdhi mino gidida asi yidi, iya qohidi xoonikko ammanettidi danccida danccuwa bilisidi, iya shaluwa bonqqidi haraas shaakkees.
“Taara gidonnayssi tana ixxees; taara shiishonnaysika laallees.
“Tuna ayyaanay asappe keyida wode shemppiyaso koyidi haathi baynnasoora yuuyees. Shemppiyaso dhayida wode, ‘Ta keyidasuwa simmana’ yaagees.
I simmiya wode keethay pitettidi lo77idi de7ishin demmis.
Hessafe guye, bidi iyappe aadhdhidi iitida haraa laappun tuna ayyaanata ekkidi yees. Iyan gelidi duussu oykkees. He uraas koyroyssafe guyeyssi aadhdhidi iita gidees” yaagis.
Yesuusi hessa oda bolla de7ishin issi maccasi asaa gaathafe denddada, ba qaala dhoqqu oothada, “Nena tookkida uloynne neeni dhammida dhanthati anjjettidosona” yaagasu.
Shin I, “Anjjettidayssati Xoossaa qaala si7idi kiitetteyssata” yaagis.
Daro asay shiiqida wode Yesuusi, “Ha yeletethay iita; ooratha malla koyees. Shin Yoonasa malaatappe attin hari enttaw imettena.
Yoonasi Nanawe asaas malla gidida mela Asa Na7aykka ha yeletethaas malla gidana.
Dugeha kawiya pirdda gallas ha yeletethaara denddada pirddana. Gaasoykka, iya Solomone cinccatethaa si7anaw biitta gaxappe denddada yasu. Hekko Solomoneppe aadhdheyssi hayssan de7ees
Nanawe asati pirdda gallas ha yeletethaara denddidi entta bolla pirddana. Gaasoykka Yoonasa sibkkatiyan maarota gelidosona. Hekko, Yoonasappe aadhdhey hayssan de7ees” yaagis.
“Xomppe xomppidi qosa bessan woykko oto giddon wothiya asi deenna. Asi poo7uwa be7ana mela dhoqqa bessan wothees.
Ne asatethaas poo7oy ne ayfiyaa. Ne ayfey lo77o gidikko, ne kumetha asatethay poo7ees. Nena ayfey sakkiko ne asatethay ubbay dhumees.
Hessa gisho, ne garssan de7iya poo7oy dhumonna mela naageeta.
Hiza, ne kumetha asatethay poo7o gidikko, ne asatethankka hari dhuma bessi dhayikko, ne asatetha kumethay wolile poo7o mela gidees” yaagis.
Yesuusi ba oda onggida mela issi Farisaawey baara kathi maana xeegis. I iyara issife gelidi gibira bolla uttis.
Farisaawey Yesuusi kathi maanappe sinthe kushe meecconayssa be7idi malaalettis.
Goday iyaakko, “Hintte Farisaaweti quuliyanne shaatiya bolla bagga meecetta. Shin hintte gaathay uuzetethaninne iitatethan kumis.
Hinttenoo, eeyato, bolla medhdhidayssi gaatha medhdhiday iya gidenneyye?
Shin quuliyaninne shaatiyan de7eyssa manqotas immite. He wode hinttew ubbabay geeshshi gidana.
“Farisaaweto hinttena ayye, sawoppe, xalooteppe, hessa melabaappe asraata kesseta. Shin xillotethinne Xoossaa dosoy hinttenan baawa. Harata aggonna hayssatakka oothanaw bessees, shin aggideta.
“Farisaaweto hinttena ayye, Ayhude Woosa Keethan bonchcho oyde, giya giddon bonchcho sarotho doseeta.
“Malay dhayin asay eronna bollara biya duufo daaneyssato hinttena ayye” yaagis.
Higge asttamaarey zaaridi, “Asttamaariyaw, ne hessa gashe nuna cayaasa” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Hinttenoo, higge asttamaareto, hinttenakka ayye, asay tookkanaw dandda7onna deexo tooho toosseeta, shin hinttee hintte huu7es hari attoshin biradhdhe xeerankka bochcheketa.
“Hintte aawati wodhida nabeta duufuwa hintte giigisiya gisho hinttena ayye.
Hiza, hintte aawata oosuwa minthanaw entti wodhida nabeta duufuwa hintte loythiya gisho, entta iita oosuwas hintte markka.
Hessa gisho, Xoossay ba cinccatethan, ‘Nabetanne hawaareta ta hinttew kiittana, shin hintte baggata wodhana; harata gooddana’ yaagis.
Hessa gisho, ha yeletethay alamey medhettoosappe hanno gakkanaw gukkida nabeta ubbaa suuthas oyshettana.
Aabelappe doomidi yarshsho bessaasinne Xoossa Keethaafe gidduwan gukkida Zakkariyaasa suutha gisho ha yeletethay oyshettana.
“Higge asttamaareto, hinttena ayye, eratetha qulppiya hintte kushen oykkideta, shin hinttew gelekketa haratakka gelsseketa.” yaagis.
Yesuusi yaappe baanaw keyaa wode higge asttamaaretinne Farisaaweti iyara eqettidi oyshon waaysosona.
Iya doonappe keyaa qaalan iya oykkanaw koyidi hessa oothidosona.
He wode daro mukulun taybettiya asay woli bolla yedhdhettana gakkanaw asi asa bolla shiiqidi de7ishin, Yesuusi ba tamaaretakko, “Farisaaweta irshshuwaafe naagettite. Hessika entta cubbotethaa.
Qoncconna qosettidi, erettonna geemmidi attiyaabay aykkoyka baawa.
Hiza, hintte dhuman odidabay ubbay poo7on si7ettana, qol77a gaathan kalkkashidabay dabaaban odettana.
“Ta baggatoo ta odeyssa si7ite; ashuwa wodhoosonappe attin haraa aykkoka oothanaw dandda7onnayssatas babbofite.
Hanoshin, hintte babbanaw besseyssa ta hinttew qonccisana. Hessika wodhidaappe guye Gaannamen yegganaw wolqqay de7eyssas iyaw babbite. Ee, tuma gays; iyaw babbite.
Ichchashu buubbeti issi santimes bayzettokonaayye? Hanoppe attin enttafe issinnaka Xoossaa sinthan dogetuku.
Hari attoshin, hintte huu7e binaanaykka paydettidi de7ees. Hiza, babbofite daro buubbetappe hintte aadhdheeta.
“Ta odeyssa si7ite; asa sinthan taw markkattiya ubbaas Asa Na7ay Xoossaa kiitanchchota sinthan markkattana.
Asa sinthan tana kaddeyssas Xoossaa kiitanchchota sinthan ta iya kaddana.
Asa Na7a bolla kadhe qaala haasayiya ubbay maarota demmana, shin Geeshsha Ayyaana bolla kadhe qaala odetteyssi maaretenna.
“Asi hinttena oykkidi Ayhude Woosa Keethan, daynnata sinthaninne kawota sinthan gooshechchiya wode ay odaneekkonne woygi zaaraneekko hirggofite.
He wode hintte odanabaa Geeshsha Ayyaanay hinttena tamaarssana” yaagis.
Asaa giddofe issi asi Yesuusakko yidi, “Ta ishay taw nu aawa laatappe shaakkana mela iyaw oda” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “La addiyaw, hintte bolla tana daynnanne laata shaakkiya cima oothiday oonee?” yaagis.
Qassika Yesuusi, “Asa de7oy shalo darotethan gidonna gisho yaare aggidi minthidi hinttena naagite” yaagis.
Kaallidikka leemison, “Gadey daro kathi immiya issi dure uray de7ees.
He uray, ‘Ta kathaa taani shiishanaw bessi guuxida gisho ay ootho?’ yaagidi ba wozanan qoppis.
Hizappe yaatana; kase de7iya shaaleta laallada haraa dalgga shaaleta keexana. Kathaanne taw de7iyaba ubbaa iyan yeggana.
Ba shemppeeko, ‘Ta shemppete, daro laythas new gidiya shalo shiishas. Hiza, shemppada ma, uya, ufaytta’ yaagana.
“Shin Xoossay, ‘La, eeya addiyaw, hachchi qamma ne shemppiya neeppe ekettawusu. Hiza, ne shiishidabay oodees gidanee?’ yaagis.
“Hessa gisho, baw duretethi sa7an shiishiya asi, Xoossaa matan dure gidonna asaas wurssethay ha urayssa mela” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi ba tamaaretakko, “Hiza, ta odiyabaa si7ite, hintte shemppuwas ay mino hintte bollaas ay ma77ino yaagidi un77ettofite.
Shemppoy kathafe bolli afilappe aadhdhees.
Kafota be7ite zerokkona, kiishokkona, eleykka shaaleykka baawa. Shin Xoossay enttana muzees. Hintte kafotappe daro aadhdheeta.
Hanoshin, hinttefe un77ettidi ba laythaa bolla issi qamma gujjanaw dandda7ey oonee?
Hiza, ha guuthabaa oothanaw dandda7onna hintte harabaas ays un77etteetii?
Ane cishshati waanidi dicciyakko be7ite. Waayokkonanne suqqokona. Hari attoshin, Solomoney ba de7iya bonchcho ubban enttafe issuwa melakka ma77ibeena.
Hinttenoo, ammanoy paccidayssato, hiza, Xoossay hachchi benttidi wontto taman yegettana cishshata hayssada mayzikko, hinttena waati aathi mayzennee?
Hessa gisho, ay mino woykko ay uyino gidi un77ettofite.
He ubbaas Xoossaa ammanonna asati un77ettoosona. Shin hintte aaway Xoossay hessi ubbay hinttew koshsheyssa erees.
Ubbaafe aathidi Xoossaa kawotethaa koyite hessi ubbay hinttew gujji imettana.
“Hinttenoo, guutha deretoo, yayyofite; hintte aawa Xoossay kawotethaa hinttew immanaw ufayttees.
Hinttew de7iyabaa bayzidi manqotas immite. Kaysoy ekkonnason, bili moonnason, cimonna karxiitan, wuronna shaluwa saluwan shiishite.
Hintte wozanay hintte shaloy de7iyasuwan gidana.
“Qanthan danccidi giigettite; hintte xomppey poo7idayssa gido.
Bantta goday yaaganoppe simmana gakkanaw barkkidi naageyssatada, goday yidi xeegiya wode ellesidi dooyanaw giigida asata daanite.
Bantta goday simmiya wode dhiskkonna de7ishe naageyssati anjjettidayssata. Tuma gays; goday qanthan danccidi gayta yuushuwan utisidi mokkees.
Goday laade gidin giddi bilahe gidin woykko wonttimaathe gidin yidi, hessa mela dhiskkonna naagishin demmiya he aylleti anjjettidayssata.
Shin hayssa erite kaysoy awude yaanekko keethaaway eriyakko keethay boketiya wode si7i gidi be7enna.
Hintteka giigidi naagite; Asa Na7ay hintte qopponna wode yaana” yaagis.
Phexiroosikka, “Godaw ha leemisuwa nu xalaalas odayye woykko asa ubbaasee?” yaagis.
Goday zaaridi, “Hiza, kathaa muzanaw bessiya wodiyan immana mela goday ba aylleta bolla shuumida ammantheysinne wozanaama halaqay oonee?
Goday simmiya wode hessa mela oothishe benttiya aylley I anjjettidayssa
Ta hinttew tuma odays; ba godaas de7iya shalo ubbaa bolla I shuumettana.
Shin he aylley, ‘Ta goday elle yeenna’ yaagidi ba wozanan qoppidi, macca aylletanne adde aylleta wadhdhiko, qassi baw koyida mela mishenne uyishe mathottiko,
he aylliya goday I qopponna gallasaninne hirggonna wode yaana. Yidi iya qanxerethidi, iya qaada ammanonna asatara oothana.
“Godaa sheniyada giigonnayssinne iya goday ay dosiyakko erishe oothonna aylley daro garaafettana.
Shin ba godaa sheniya eronna attidi garaafettanaw besseyssa oothiday guuthara garaafettana. Gaasoykka daro imettidayssafe daro koyettees, daro hadara ekkidayssafekka daro immana gidi naagettees.
“Taani yiday biitta bolla tama oythanaassa. Ha77i tamay oykkiyako tana waati ufayssanddeshsha!
Hanoshin, ta ha77i xammaqettiya xinqqatey de7ees. I polettana gakkanaw ta daro un77ettays.
Sa7a bolla sarotethi ehanaw yida hinttew daanii? Gidenna, ta yiday shaakkanaassa.
Ha77ife doomidi woli giddon shaakettida ichchashu keethaa asati issife de7oosona. Nam77ati heedzata bolla, heedzatikka nam77ata bolla, denddidi shaakettoosona.
Aaway na7aa bolla, na7aykka aawa bolla, aayiya na7ee bolla, na7iya aaye bolla, azinaa aayiya na7aa machche bolla, na7aa machchiya azinaa aaye bolla, denddidi shaakettana.”
Qassika asaakko, “Wuloha baggara saloy shaaratiya wode be7idi, ellesidi, ‘Iri yaana’ yaageta, hessadakka hanees.
Dugeha carkkoy carkkiya wode ‘Sa7ay awana’ yaageta, hessadakka hanees” yaagis.
Hinttenoo, cubboto, Salobaanne sa7abaa shaakki ereetashin ha wodiya shaakki eroy hinttena waanidi xoonidee?
“Yaatin, hintte huu7es ays tuma pirddeketii?
Ne morkkiyara wolla daynna sinthan eqqanaw bashe oge bolla giiganaw koya. Ne giigonna ixxiko gooshechchidi daynna sinthi nena efana. Daynnay nena polisees aathi immana. I nena woynen yeggana.
Si7ite, issi bakkani attonna cigga onggana gakkanaw ne yaappe keyonnayssa era” yaagis.
He wode Yesuusakko asay yidi Philaaxoosi wodhidi entta suuthaara entta yarshshuwa walakkida Galiila asaabaa odida asati he bessan de7oosona.
I hayssada yaagidi zaaris; “Yaatin he Galiila asati he iita hayqo hayqqida gisho, Galiilan de7iya asa ubbaafe aadhdhida nagaranchcho daanoona?
Gidenna! Gidoshin, hintteka maarotan simmona ixxiko, ubbay hessada dhayana.
Woykko qassi Salihoome giya bessan gimbbey woddidi wodhida tammanne hosppun asay Yerusalaamen de7iya asa ubbaafe aadhdhida nagaranchcho daanoona?
Gidenna! Shin hintteka maarotan simmona ixxiko ubbay hessada dhayana.”
Qassika Yesuusi hayssada gidi leemiso odis; “Issi uraas woyne gaden tokettida balase mithiya de7awusu. I iippe ayfe koyii yidi aykkoka demmibeenna.
Gadiya goday woyne oosanchchuwakko, ‘Ayfe demmanaw koyada heedzu laythi simerettada aykkoka demmabiikke. Hessa gisho, qanxa digga; ays biittaa melisay?’ yaagis.
“Shin oosanchchoy, ‘Godaw, I yuushuwa oothada osha yeggana gakkanaw ha laythas aggarkii.
Ha laythi ayfikko lo77o, ixxiko qanxa agga’ ” yaagidi zaaris.
Yesuusi Sambbaata gallas Ayhude Woosa Keethan tamaarssees.
He bessan tammanne hosppun laythi tuna ayyaani zokko kuunisida issi maccasiya de7awusu. Iya kuunappe denddoyssan suure eqqanaw dandda7ukku.
Yesuusi iyo be7ida wode xeegidi, “Ha maccasete, ne harggiyafe paxadasa” yaagis.
Ba kushiya I bolla wothin, iya sohuwara suurada eqqasu. Xoossaaka galatasu.
Shin Ayhude Woosa Keetha halaqay yilotidi asaakko, “Oosoy oosettiya usuppun gallasati de7oosona. Hessa gisho, he gallasatan yidi paxiteppe attin Sambbaata gallas gidenna” yaagis.
Goday, “Cubboto, hintte giddofe boori woykko hare Sambbaata gallas zadalope billidi haathe ushshanaw efonnay oonee?
Yaatin, ha maccasiya Abrahaame na7aa gidashe xalahen qashettada tammanne hosppun laythi kumethi de7idaaris Sambbaata gallas birshshetethi koshshennee?” yaagidi oychchis.
I hessa odida wode eqetteyssati ubbay yeellatidosona. Shin asay ubbay I oothida malaalisiya ooso ubban ufayttidosona.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi hayssada yaagis, “Xoossaa kawotethay ay daanii? Iya aybira daaniso?
Xoossaa kawotethay issi asi ba goshshan tokkida wola ayfe mela. I diccidi mithi gidis. Salo kafoti iya tashiya bolla shemppidosona.
Qassi, “Xoossaa kawotethaa aybira daaniso?
Issi maccasiya daro dhiillera walakkada munuqida guutha irshsho daanees” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi Yerusalaame bishe I kanthiya ogiyan de7iya katamataninne gutatan tamaarssishe aadhdhis.
Issi asi Yesuusakko, “Godaw, attanay guutha asa xalaalee?” yaagidi oychchis. Yesuusi enttako,
“Si7ite, xuuntha wulaara gelanaw baaxetite. Daroti gelanaw koyoosona shin enttaw hanenna.
Keethaaway denddidi wulaa gorddidaappe guye, ‘Nuus dooyarkii’ yaagishe karen eqqidi xeessi oykkeeta. Shin I, ‘Hintte ooneekkonne awuppe yidaakko ta erikke’ gidi zaarana.
He wode hintte, ‘Neera wolla mida, uyida, nu dabaabankka tamaarssadasa’ yaagana.
“I zaaridi, ‘Hintte ooneekkonne awuppe yidaakko erikke. Hinttenoo, geellato taappe haakkite’ yaagana.
Abrahaame, Yisaaqa, Yayqoobanne nabeta ubbaa Xoossaa kawotethan be7ana, shin hintte karen wodhdhidi attiyaa wode hinttew yeehonne achche garccethi gidana.
Asay dolohappe, wulohappe, pudehappenne dugehappe yidi Xoossaa kawotethan gibira bolla uttana.
Hessa gisho, ha77i dethan guye gididayssatappe sinthe gidanayssati, sinthe gididayssatappe guye gidanayssati de7oosona” yaagis.
He wode Farisaawetappe issoti issoti yidi, “Heroodisi nena wodhanaw koyaa gisho ha bessafe denddada ba gidosona.
I zaaridi, “Bidi, he workkanaas hekko, ‘Hachchinne wontto tuna ayyaanata kessana, hargganchchota pathana, heedzantho gallasan kuushsha bolla gakkana’ yaagis giite.
Hanoppe attin, nabey Yerusalaameppe karen hayqqanaw bessenna. Hessa gisho, hachchi, wonttonne wontti fee7in he bessaa baanaw denddas.

“Yerusalaame, Yerusalaame, nabeta wodhiyare, neekko kiitettidayssata shuchchan caddiyare, kuttoy ba nayta ba qefiyappe garssan shiishiyada ne nayta ta qesiyappe garssan aappun toho shiishanaw koyadina, shin hintte ixxas gideta.
Ta hinttew odays; hintte keethay kaysattana. Godaa sunthan yeyssi anjjettidayssa hintte gaana gakkanaw tana demmeketa” yaagis.
Issi Sambbaata gallas Yesuusi issi Farisaaweta halaqaa soo kathi maanaw geliya wode asay caddi xeellosona.
He bessan shawuhe harggen waayettiya issi asi iyaw sintha baggara zin77is.
Yesuusi Farisaawetakkonne higge asttamaaretakko, “Sambbaata gallas hargganchcho pasoy wogeyye woga gidennee?” yaagidi oychchis.
Entti si7i gidosona. Yesuusi harggettiya uraa bochchi pathidi moyzis.
“Qassika hinttefe issuwas na7i woykko boori Sambbaata gallas aafon wulliko ellesidi kessonnay oonee?”
Entti issibaakka zaaranaw dandda7ibookkona.
Yesuusi imatuwas xeegettidayssati bonchcho bessi doorishin be7idi, ha leemisuwa odis.
“Issi asi nena yaagano xeegikko bonchcho bessan uttofa. Neeppe aadhdhi bonchchettiya asi xeegettanaw dandda7ees.
Hinttena nam77atakka xeegidayssi yidi, ‘Ne bessaa ha imathaas yedda’ yaagiya wode neeni yeellatashe ziqqa bessi wodhdhaasa.
Gidoshin, ne xeegettida wode koyrottada ziqqa bessi be7ada utta. Xeegoyssi yidi, ‘Ta laggiyaw, ha bonchcho bessan utta’ yaagana. He wode neera issife xeegettida asa ubbaa sinthan ne bonchchettana.
Bana dhoqqu dhoqqu oothiya ubbay kawuyana; bana ziqqi ziqqi oothiya ubbay dhoqqu dhoqqu gaana.”
Qassi Yesuusi iya mokkida keethaa aawakko, “Quma woykko kaho imato xeegiya wode, neeni kushe zaaro xeegonna mela ne laggeta woykko ne ishata woykko ne dabbota woykko ne dure shoorota imato xeegoppa.
Gidoshin, ne imato giigisida wode manqota, wobbeta, gunddatanne qooqeta xeega; neeni anjjettana.
Hayssati kushe zaaranaw dandda7onna gisho kushe zaaroy geeshshata denddo gallasan new simmana” yaagis.
Yesuusara wolla imato bolla uttoyssata giddofe issoy hessa si7idi, “Xoossaa kawotethan imato bolla utteyssi anjjettidayssa” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Issi asi gita imato giigisidi daro asata xeegis.
Imatoy mokettiya saatey gakkiya wode xeegettida imathata, ‘Hekko ubbabay giigis, haa yiite’ yaagidi xeeganaada ba aylliya kiittis.
“Shin ubbayka bantta gaaso gaaso medhdhidosona. Issoy, ‘Ha77i buroo gade shammida gisho, bada be7anaw koshshees hayyana tana aggarkii yaaga’ yaagis.
Hankkoy, ‘Ichchashu waatha boori shammas enttana waaxa be7ana gisho hayyana tana lanccofa’ yaagis.
Qassi haray, ‘Taani buroo meddan de7iya gisho, yaanaw dandda7ikke’ yaagis.
“Aylley simmi yidi he ubbaa ba godaas odis. He wode yaagano aaway hanqettidi aylliyako, ‘Ellesada kataman de7iya wogga ogetanne daggalata bada, manqota, wobbeta, qooqetanne gunddata haa eha’ yaagis.
“Aylley, ‘Ta godaw, ne kiittidayssi ubbay polettis, shin ha77ika bessi de7ees’ yaagis.
“Goday aylliyako, ‘Horogata bollanne, gade giddo ogeta keya, ta keethay kumana gakkanaw demmida ubbaa yaana mela ootha.
Ta hinttew odays; imatotidayssatappe oonikka ta gibiraappe moonnayssa erite’ gis” yaagis.
Daro asay iyara wolla bishin Yesuusi enttako guye simmidi,
“Taakko yaa ubbay ba aawanne, ba aayiw, ba machchiwunne ba nayta, ba ishatanne ba michcheta, hari attoshin ba de7uwa ixxonnay ta tamaare gidanaw dandda7enna.
Ba masqaliya tookkidi tana kaallonnay ta tamaare gidanaw dandda7enna.
“Hinttefe issi asi shuchcha keethi keexanaw koykko, keethaa keexidi ongganaw ay mela miishe koshshiyako koyrottidi eranaw qoppi be7onnay oonee?
Hessa gidonna ixxiko, ha uray baaso shuchchu hiixin qusttethi xoonikko,
be7iya ubbay, ‘Ha uray gimbbethi oykkin qusttanaw iya xoonis’ yaagidi boroosona.
“Woykko issi kawoy hara kawora olettanaw denddishe laatamu mukulu olanchchota ekki yaa kawuwara tammu mukulu olanchchotara eqettanaw dandda7anayssanne dandda7onayssa uttidi zorettonnay oonee?
Eqettanaw dandda7ettonaba gidikko, he hara kawuwara haahon de7ishin giiganaw koyrottidi cima yeddidi oychchees.
Hessadakka, hinttefe oonikka baw de7iyaba ubbaa aggonna ixxiko ta tamaare gidanaw dandda7enna.
“Maxiney lo77o, shin maxiney ba mal7uwa aggiko, waanidi maxine geetettanaw dandda7ii?
Biittatethaaskka araddatethaaskka maaddonabaa gidiya gisho wora yegettees. Hiza, si7iya haythi de7iya asi si7o” yaagis.
Issi gallas qaraxa qanxeyssatinne nagaranchchoti Yesuusa timirttiya si7anaw iya yuushuwan shiiqidosona.
Shin Farisaawetinne higge asttamaareti, “Hayssi uray nagaranchchota shiishidi ekkees, enttara issife mees” yaagidi zuuzummidosona.
Yesuusi yaagidi hayssa leemiso enttaw odis;
“Hintte giddofe issuwas xeetu dorssati de7iyabaa gidikko enttafe issoy dhayikko uddufun tammanne uddufunata bazzon aggidi dhayoyssa demmana gakkanaw koyonnay oonee?
Demmida wode ufayttidi ba gannan tookkidi,
ba soo simmees. Ba laggettanne shoorota issife xeegidi, ‘Dhayida ta dorssaa demmas, taara issife ufayttite’ yaagees.
Hessadakka, maaroti koshshonna uddufun tammanne uddufun xillotappe aathidi maarotan geliya issi nagaranchchuwa gaason salon gita ufayssi gidees.
“Woykko tammu biri de7iya issi maccasiya tammaafe issiya dhayikko demmana gakkanaw xomppe oythada keethaa pittada mintha koyonnara oonee?
Demmida wode ba laggettanne ba shoorota xeegada ‘Dhayida ta issi bira demmida gisho taara wolla ufayttite’ yaagawusu.
Si7ite, hessa mela issi maarotethan geliya nagaranchchuwan Xoossaa kiitanchchota sinthan ufayssi gidees” yaagis.
Zaaridi Yesuusi, “Issi uraas nam77u nayti de7oosona.
Enttafe kaalo na7ay ba aawakko, ‘Ta aawaw, ne shaluwappe ta gishuwa taw imma’ yaagis. Aaway ba shaluwa ba naytas shaakkis.
Guutha gallasappe guye kaalo na7ay ba gishuwa ubbaa qachchi ekkidi haaho biitta bis. Yan alttacan shaluwa toochchidi onggis.
I baw de7iyaba ubbaa wurssidaappe guye he biitta ubban mino koshi keyin metootis.
Hessa gisho, he biittaa asaappe issuwa soo gaata gelis. Uray iya guduntho heemmana mela ba moothaa yeddis.
Gudunthoti miya harquwafe maanaw amottis, shin iyokka iyaw immiya asi benttibeenna.
Wozani simmin, ‘Aappun ta aawa aylletas kathi wora wodhdhin ta hayssan koshara hayqqanaw gakkadina?’
Denddada ta aawakko bada, ‘Ta aawaw, salon Xoossaa, sa7an nena qohas.
Hizappe ne na7a geetettada xeegettanaw taw bessonna gisho, ne son de7iya aylletappe issuwada tana payda’ yaagana” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, denddidi ba aawakko bis. “Hanoshin, I buroo haahon de7ishin aaway qadhettidi, iyaakko woxxi bidi idimmidi yeeris.
Na7aykka, ‘Ta aawaw salon Xoossaa, sa7an nena ta qohas. Hizappe ne na7a geetettada xeegettanaw bessike’ yaagis.
“Iya aaway aylleta xeegidi, ‘Ellesidi ubbaafe lo77o gidida ma7o ehidi iya mayzite; iya biradhdhen sagaayo, iya tohuwan caamma aathite.
Modhdho gatarmentho ehidi shukkite, moos, ufayttoos.
Ta na7ay hayssi hayqqis, shin ha77i paxis; dhays, shin benttis’ yaagis. Hessafe guye, ufayetethi oykkidosona.
“He wode bayra na7ay goshsha gaden de7ees. Yaappe yishe soo matishin yethinne gufa girssi si7is.
I, aylletappe issuwa xeegidi haniyabay aybeekko eranaw oychchis.
Aylley, ‘Ne ishay saro yida gisho ne aaway modhdho gatarmentho iyaw shukkis’ yaagis.
“Bayra ishay yilotidi soo gelanawukka koyibeenna. Aaway kare keyidi soo gelana mela iya woossis.
Shin I ba aawakko, ‘Hekko, hayssa mela laythi ta new aylletada ne kiitaappe issuwaka pacisonna new kiitettin ta ta laggetara ufayttana mela hari attoshin issi laaqa deeshe immabaakka.
Hanoshin, hayssi ne na7ay ne shaluwa laymatara doomisidi yin modhdho gatarmentho shukkadasa’ ” yaagis.
“Aawaykka, ‘Ta na7aw, neeni ubba wode taara de7aasa, tabay ubbay neessa.
Hayssi ne ishay hayqqis, shin paxis; dhays, shin benttis. Hessa gisho, daro ufayttanaw bessees’ yaagana” yaagis.
Yesuusi ba tamaaretakko, “Issi dure uraas iyappe garssara issi shuumay de7ees. He shuumay ba godaa shaluwa toochchees yaagiya worey keethaawa gakkis.
Keethaaway shuumaa xeegisidi, ‘Taani woygiyabaa si7adinaa? Hizappe neeni ta keethas shuuma gidada oothanaw dandda7onna gisho ta shaluwa taw sheedhdha’ yaagis.
“He shuumaykka ba wozanan hayssada yaagidi qoppis. ‘Ta goday tana shuumatethaafe wothana hanees, goya aqanaw wolqqi baawa, woossa maanaw yeellayees; yaatin ta waano?
Shuumatethaafe ta wodhdhiya wode asay tana mokkana mela oothanabaa ta erays’ yaagis.
“Hessa gisho, iya godaa acoy de7iya asaa issuwa issuwa xeegi ehidi koyro uraakko, ‘Ne bolla ta godaa acoy ay meli de7ii?’ yaagidi oychchis.
“I, ‘Laatamu barmeele zayte acoy de7ees’ yaagis. “Shuumay, ‘Wule warqattiya he7e, ellesada, tammu barmeele zayte acoy de7ees gada xaafa’ yaagis.
“Hessafe kaallidi nam77anthuwako, ‘New aappuni de7ii?’ yaagis. “I, ‘370 kunttaale gistte acoy de7ees’ yaagis. “Shuumay, “Ne wule warqattiya he7e, ellesada, 296 kunttaale yaagada xaafa’ yaagis.
Keethaaway ammanettiboonna shuumaa iya bilaamatethaas nashshis. Ha alamiya nayti ase oythan poo7o naytappe aadhdhida wozanaamata.
“Hessa gisho, ta hinttew odays; ha alamiya miishey wuriya wode merinaa keethan mokettana mela ha miishiyara hinttew laggeta shammite.
Ubbaafe guuthaban ammanettiday daroban ammanettidayssa gidees. Qassi ubbaafe guuthaban ammanettonnayssi daroban ammanettenna.
Hiza, ha alamiya miishen hintte ammanettonna ixxiko tuma miishe hinttew ooni hadara immanee?
